declarations.name: GaugeBoson.TransformsAsGaugeField
declarations.doc:
A family `A` of gauge-field symbols `∂_s A_μ^φ` transforms as a gauge field under the
representation `repGauge` of the jet gauge group. A jet `U` acts on `∂_s A_μ^φ` by the
Leibniz convolution of the dual adjoint Taylor coefficients of `U⁻¹` against lower symbols,
the multiset antidiagonal carrying the multinomial coefficients, plus the base-point value of
the `s`-th derivative of the Maurer–Cartan form of `U⁻¹`.

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.LorentzTransformsAsGaugeField
declarations.doc:
A family `A` of gauge-field symbols transforms as a gauge field under the Lorentz
representation `repLorentz`. The symbol carries one covector index, and each derivative slot
transforms as a covector.

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.algebraMap_maurerCartan_structure
declarations.doc:
The structural equation of the Maurer–Cartan form of `U⁻¹`, at every derivative order, read
through a dual vector into the scalars of `B`.
declarations.statement:
lemma algebraMap_maurerCartan_structure (U : G.gaugeJetGroup) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) :
    algebraMap ℂ B (φ (G.evalLie (G.iteratedDerivJ (μ ::ₘ s) (-G.maurerCartan U⁻¹ ν)))) =
      algebraMap ℂ B (φ (G.evalLie (G.iteratedDerivJ (ν ::ₘ s) (-G.maurerCartan U⁻¹ μ))))
      - (s.antidiagonal.map fun p => algebraMap ℂ B (φ ⁅G.evalLie (G.iteratedDerivJ p.1
          (-G.maurerCartan U⁻¹ μ)), G.evalLie (G.iteratedDerivJ p.2
          (-G.maurerCartan U⁻¹ ν))⁆)).sum

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.TransformsAsGaugeField.repGauge_cons
declarations.doc:
The `κ ::ₘ s` case of the gauge law, with the extra derivative traced through. The result
is the Leibniz splittings where `κ` stays a derivative, minus (by
`GlobalGaugeGroup.adjointDualCoeff_cons`) the splittings where `κ` hits the adjoint, an
`ad` of the derived Maurer–Cartan form, plus the derived Maurer–Cartan shift.
declarations.statement:
lemma TransformsAsGaugeField.repGauge_cons
    (U : G.gaugeJetGroup) (κ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (τ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) :
    repGauge U (A (κ ::ₘ s) τ φ) =
      (s.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
        A (κ ::ₘ p.2) τ (G.adjointDualCoeff U⁻¹ p.1 φ)).sum
      - (s.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
          (p.1.antidiagonal.map fun q =>
            A p.2 τ (G.adjointDualCoeff U⁻¹ q.2
              (φ ∘ₗ LieAlgebra.ad ℝ G.lieSubalgebra (G.evalLie
                (G.iteratedDerivJ q.1
                  (-G.maurerCartan U⁻¹ κ)))))).sum).sum
      + algebraMap ℂ B (φ (G.evalLie (G.iteratedDerivJ (κ ::ₘ s)
          (-G.maurerCartan U⁻¹ τ))))

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.TransformsAsGaugeField.repGauge_commutatorFam
declarations.doc:
The all-orders gauge transformation of the derived commutator term. It is the Leibniz
convolution of the transformed commutator, the two `ad` cross-term convolutions,
and the convolution of Maurer–Cartan bracket shifts, at every derivative order
simultaneously. The four-fold splitting is regrouped by `sum_bracketFam_conv_eq`.
declarations.statement:
lemma TransformsAsGaugeField.repGauge_commutatorFam
    (U : G.gaugeJetGroup) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) :
    repGauge U (commutatorFam A μ ν s φ) =
      (s.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
        commutatorFam A μ ν p.2 (G.adjointDualCoeff U⁻¹ p.1 φ)).sum
      + (s.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
          (p.2.antidiagonal.map fun r =>
            A r.2 ν (G.adjointDualCoeff U⁻¹ r.1
              (φ ∘ₗ LieAlgebra.ad ℝ G.lieSubalgebra (G.evalLie
                (G.iteratedDerivJ p.1
                  (-G.maurerCartan U⁻¹ μ)))))).sum).sum
      - (s.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
          (p.1.antidiagonal.map fun q =>
            A q.2 μ (G.adjointDualCoeff U⁻¹ q.1
              (φ ∘ₗ LieAlgebra.ad ℝ G.lieSubalgebra (G.evalLie
                (G.iteratedDerivJ p.2
                  (-G.maurerCartan U⁻¹ ν)))))).sum).sum
      + (s.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
          algebraMap ℂ B (φ ⁅G.evalLie (G.iteratedDerivJ p.1
              (-G.maurerCartan U⁻¹ μ)),
            G.evalLie (G.iteratedDerivJ p.2
              (-G.maurerCartan U⁻¹ ν))⁆)).sum

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.TransformsAsGaugeField.repGauge_fieldStrength
declarations.doc:
The field strength transforms in the adjoint, at every derivative order. Under a gauge
jet `U` every derivative symbol of `F_μν` transforms by the pure Leibniz convolution of the
dual adjoint action over the multiset antidiagonal. This is the gauge law of the symbols
with no Maurer–Cartan shift, since the field strength transforms homogeneously. The
`κ`-into-the-adjoint splittings of the derivative terms (`TransformsAsGaugeField.repGauge_cons`)
cancel the `ad` cross-term convolutions of the commutator
(`TransformsAsGaugeField.repGauge_commutatorFam`) through the coassociativity and swap of
the antidiagonal, and the derived Maurer–Cartan shifts cancel the bracket-shift
convolution through the all-orders structural equation.
declarations.statement:
lemma TransformsAsGaugeField.repGauge_fieldStrength
    (U : G.gaugeJetGroup) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) :
    repGauge U (fieldStrength A μ ν s φ) =
      (s.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
        fieldStrength A μ ν p.2 (G.adjointDualCoeff U⁻¹ p.1 φ)).sum

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.TransformsAsGaugeField.transformsInAdjoint_fieldStrength
declarations.doc:
The field strength is an adjoint gauge tensor. This packages
`TransformsAsGaugeField.repGauge_fieldStrength` as `TransformsInAdjoint`, the base case of
the covariant-derivative recursion `TransformsInAdjoint.covDerivAdjoint`.
declarations.statement:
lemma TransformsAsGaugeField.transformsInAdjoint_fieldStrength
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : TransformsInAdjoint G repGauge (fieldStrength A μ ν)

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.TransformsInAdjoint.repGauge_bracketFamConv
declarations.doc:
The all-orders gauge transformation of the derived bracket `⁅A_ρ, F⁆` against an
adjoint gauge tensor `F`. Since `F` transforms homogeneously, only one `ad` cross-term
convolution survives. This is the analogue of `TransformsAsGaugeField.repGauge_commutatorFam`
with a gauge tensor in the second slot.
declarations.statement:
lemma TransformsInAdjoint.repGauge_bracketFamConv
    {F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra →ₗ[ℝ] B}
    (hF : TransformsInAdjoint G repGauge F)
    (U : G.gaugeJetGroup) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) :
    repGauge U (bracketFamConv A ρ F s φ) =
      (s.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
        bracketFamConv A ρ F p.2 (G.adjointDualCoeff U⁻¹ p.1 φ)).sum
      + (s.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
          (p.2.antidiagonal.map fun r =>
            F r.2 (G.adjointDualCoeff U⁻¹ r.1
              (φ ∘ₗ LieAlgebra.ad ℝ G.lieSubalgebra (G.evalLie
                (G.iteratedDerivJ p.1
                  (-G.maurerCartan U⁻¹ ρ)))))).sum).sum

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.TransformsInAdjoint.covDerivAdjoint
declarations.doc:
Adjoint gauge tensors are closed under the covariant derivative. If `F` transforms in the
adjoint, so does `∇_ρ F = [∂_ρ F] + ⁅A_ρ, F⁆`. The single inhomogeneous convolution of
`[∂_{ρ ::ₘ s} F]` (`TransformsInAdjoint.repGauge_cons`) cancels the single `ad` cross-term
convolution of `⁅A_ρ, F⁆` (`TransformsInAdjoint.repGauge_bracketFamConv`) through the
coassociativity of the antidiagonal, and no structural equation is needed. Together with
`TransformsAsGaugeField.transformsInAdjoint_fieldStrength` this makes every iterated
covariant derivative of the field strength an adjoint gauge tensor, by recursion.
declarations.statement:
lemma TransformsInAdjoint.covDerivAdjoint
    {F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra →ₗ[ℝ] B}
    (hF : TransformsInAdjoint G repGauge F) (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    TransformsInAdjoint G repGauge (GaugeBoson.covDerivAdjoint A F ρ)

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.TransformsAsGaugeField.transformsInAdjoint_iteratedCovDerivAdjoint
declarations.doc:
Every iterated covariant derivative of the field strength is an adjoint gauge tensor, by
the recursion of `TransformsInAdjoint.covDerivAdjoint` over the list of directions, from
the base case `TransformsAsGaugeField.transformsInAdjoint_fieldStrength`.
declarations.statement:
lemma TransformsAsGaugeField.transformsInAdjoint_iteratedCovDerivAdjoint (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (ν lam : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    TransformsInAdjoint G repGauge
      (iteratedCovDerivAdjoint A l (fieldStrength A ν lam))

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.TransformsAsGaugeField.repGauge_fieldStrengthTower_of_mem_truncationKer_zero
declarations.doc: The covariant derivatives of the field strength are invariant under the pure jets.
declarations.statement:
lemma TransformsAsGaugeField.repGauge_fieldStrengthTower_of_mem_truncationKer_zero
    (U : G.truncationKer 0)
    (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (ν lam : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) :
    repGauge U.1 (iteratedCovDerivAdjoint A l (fieldStrength A ν lam) 0 φ) =
      iteratedCovDerivAdjoint A l (fieldStrength A ν lam) 0 φ

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.TransformsAsGaugeField.repGauge_symmetrizedDeriv
declarations.doc:
The gauge transformation of the symmetrized derivatives. Averaging the gauge law of the
individual derivative symbols over the multiset `s`, the homogeneous part is the
symmetrized adjoint convolution, and the inhomogeneous Maurer–Cartan shifts average to
exactly the base-point value of the symmetrized Maurer–Cartan form of `U⁻¹`,

`U • sym(∂_s A)^φ = (1/|s|) ∑_{μ ∈ s} ∑_{x+y=s−μ} ∂_y A_μ^{∂_x Ad*(U⁻¹) φ}`
`                   + φ( sym(ω(U⁻¹))_s |₀ )`.
declarations.statement:
lemma TransformsAsGaugeField.repGauge_symmetrizedDeriv
    (U : G.gaugeJetGroup) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) :
    repGauge U (symmetrizedDeriv s A φ) =
      (1/(s.card : ℝ)) • (s.map fun μ =>
        ((s - {μ}).antidiagonal.map fun p =>
          A p.2 μ (G.adjointDualCoeff U⁻¹ p.1 φ)).sum).sum
      + algebraMap ℂ B (φ (G.evalLie (G.symmetrizedMaurerCartanForm U⁻¹ s)))

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.TransformsAsGaugeField.repGauge_symmetrizedDeriv_truncationKer
declarations.doc:
A pure jet acts on the symmetrized derivatives through the symmetrized Maurer–Cartan
data. For a gauge jet `U` with identity value, the inhomogeneous shift of `sym(∂_s A)^φ`
is the pairing of `φ` with the symmetrized Maurer–Cartan coefficient of `U⁻¹` at `s`, the
very data that classifies pure jets.
declarations.statement:
lemma TransformsAsGaugeField.repGauge_symmetrizedDeriv_truncationKer
    (U : G.truncationKer 0) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (hs : s ≠ 0)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) :
    repGauge U.1 (symmetrizedDeriv s A φ) =
      (1/(s.card : ℝ)) • (s.map fun μ =>
        ((s - {μ}).antidiagonal.map fun p =>
          A p.2 μ (G.adjointDualCoeff (U.1)⁻¹ p.1 φ)).sum).sum
      + algebraMap ℂ B (φ (G.symmetrizedMaurerCartanCoeff U⁻¹ ⟨s, hs⟩))

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.TransformsAsGaugeField.repGauge_symmetrizedDeriv_translation
declarations.doc:
Pure translation. When all positive dual adjoint coefficients of `U⁻¹` below the order
of `s` vanish, the adjoint convolution in the transformation of the symmetrized symbol
collapses to the symbol itself, and the action is a translation by the symmetrized
Maurer–Cartan coefficient.
declarations.statement:
lemma TransformsAsGaugeField.repGauge_symmetrizedDeriv_translation
    (U : G.truncationKer 0) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (hs : s ≠ 0)
    (hU : ∀ x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), x ≠ 0 → x.card < s.card →
      G.adjointDualCoeff (U.1)⁻¹ x = 0)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) :
    repGauge U.1 (symmetrizedDeriv s A φ) =
      symmetrizedDeriv s A φ +
        algebraMap ℂ B (φ (G.symmetrizedMaurerCartanCoeff U⁻¹ ⟨s, hs⟩))

modules.title: The generation theorem for the gauge-field symbols
modules.doc:
The symbols of a gauge field generate the same algebra as its symmetrized derivatives together
with the covariant derivatives of its field strength.

## i. Overview

The derivative symbols `∂_s A_μ` of a gauge field are not all independent modulo the
covariant objects. The antisymmetric parts of the derivatives assemble into the field
strength and its covariant derivatives, and what remains is the symmetrized derivative

  `sym(∂_s A)_μ := (1/|s|) ∑_{ν ∈ s} ∂_{s − ν} A_ν`,

with the direction of the field averaged into the derivative multiset. The generation theorem
`symbolAdjoin_eq_symFieldAdjoin` says that the algebra generated by the symbols `∂_s A_μ` of
order at most `n` is generated by the symmetrized symbols of order at most `n + 1` together
with the covariant derivatives of the field strength of order less than `n`.

Everything here holds for any family of symbols in any algebra `B`. No commutativity and no
gauge action are used. The classification of gauge invariants built on this theorem is in
`PhyslibAlpha.ClassicalFieldTheory.GaugeTheory.GaugeBoson.AdjointFamily.Classification`.

## ii. Key results

- `GaugeBoson.symmetrizedDeriv` : the symmetrized derivative symbols.
- `GaugeBoson.symbolsLE`, `GaugeBoson.symSymbolsLE`, `GaugeBoson.towerLT` : the generating
  sets of the three towers, filtered by order.
- `GaugeBoson.symbolAdjoin_eq_symFieldAdjoin` : the generation theorem.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The symmetrized derivative symbols
- B. The generating sets
- C. The generation theorem

## iv. References

* None.

sections.text: ## A. The symmetrized derivative symbols

## B. The generating sets

The three towers appearing in the generation theorem and the classification: the derivative
symbols `∂_p A_μ`, the symmetrized symbols `sym(∂_r A)`, and the covariant derivatives
`𝒟_l F` of the field strength, each filtered by the number of derivatives.

## C. The generation theorem

The chain of lemmas below leads to

  `adjoin({ ∂_p A }) = adjoin({ sym(∂_p A) } ∪ { 𝒟_q F })`.

With the derivative symbols as primitives no Leibniz hypothesis is needed: the covariant
derivative of a family shifts the derivative index and adds a bracket convolution, both of
which stay inside the symbol subalgebras by construction.

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.symmetrizedDeriv
declarations.doc:
The symmetrized derivative symbol `sym(∂_s A)^φ`, the average over the directions
`μ ∈ s` of the symbols `∂_{s−μ} A_μ^φ`, so that the direction of the gauge field is
symmetrized into the derivative multiset.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def symmetrizedDeriv (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (A : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) : B

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.symmetrizedDeriv_singleton
declarations.statement:
lemma symmetrizedDeriv_singleton (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (A : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) : symmetrizedDeriv ({μ}) A φ = A 0 μ φ

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.deriv_sub_symmetrizedDeriv_eq_sum
declarations.doc:
The symmetrization defect of a symbol, the average of its differences with the symbols
in which one derivative direction has been exchanged with the field direction.
declarations.statement:
lemma deriv_sub_symmetrizedDeriv_eq_sum (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (A : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra →ₗ[ℝ] B)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    A s μ φ - symmetrizedDeriv (μ ::ₘ s) A φ =
      ((1/(s.card + 1 : ℝ)) • ((s.map fun ν => A s μ φ - A (μ ::ₘ s - {ν}) ν φ).sum))

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.symmetrizedDerivₗ
declarations.doc: The symmetrized symbols are linear in the dual index.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def symmetrizedDerivₗ (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (A : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra →ₗ[ℝ] B) :
    Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra →ₗ[ℝ] B

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.symmetrizedDeriv_eq_sum_coord
declarations.doc: The expansion of a symmetrized symbol in a basis of the gauge algebra.
declarations.statement:
lemma symmetrizedDeriv_eq_sum_coord {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (bv : Module.Basis ι ℝ G.lieSubalgebra)
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) :
    symmetrizedDeriv s A φ = ∑ j, φ (bv j) • symmetrizedDeriv s A (bv.coord j)

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.symbolsLE
declarations.doc: The derivative symbols `∂_p A_μ^φ` with at most `n` derivatives.
declarations.statement: abbrev symbolsLE (n : ℕ) : Set B

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.symbols
declarations.doc: All derivative symbols `∂_p A_μ^φ`.
declarations.statement: abbrev symbols : Set B

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.symSymbolsLE
declarations.doc: The symmetrized symbols `sym(∂_r A)^φ` with at least one and at most `n` derivatives.
declarations.statement: abbrev symSymbolsLE (n : ℕ) : Set B

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.towerLT
declarations.doc:
The covariant derivatives `𝒟_l F_{ν λ}^φ` of the field strength with fewer than `n`
derivatives.
declarations.statement: abbrev towerLT (n : ℕ) : Set B

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.tower
declarations.doc: All covariant derivatives `𝒟_l F_{ν λ}^φ` of the field strength.
declarations.statement: abbrev tower : Set B

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.symbolsLE_mono
declarations.statement: lemma symbolsLE_mono {n m : ℕ} (hnm : n ≤ m) : symbolsLE A n ⊆ symbolsLE A m

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.symbolsLE_subset_symbols
declarations.statement: lemma symbolsLE_subset_symbols (n : ℕ) : symbolsLE A n ⊆ symbols A

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.symSymbolsLE_mono
declarations.statement: lemma symSymbolsLE_mono {n m : ℕ} (hnm : n ≤ m) : symSymbolsLE A n ⊆ symSymbolsLE A m

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.towerLT_mono
declarations.statement: lemma towerLT_mono {n m : ℕ} (hnm : n ≤ m) : towerLT A n ⊆ towerLT A m

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.towerLT_subset_tower
declarations.statement: lemma towerLT_subset_tower (n : ℕ) : towerLT A n ⊆ tower A

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.adjoin_symbols_mono
declarations.doc: Symbol subalgebras are monotone in the order bound.
declarations.statement:
lemma adjoin_symbols_mono {n m : ℕ} (hnm : n ≤ m) :
    Algebra.adjoin ℂ (symbolsLE A n) ≤ Algebra.adjoin ℂ (symbolsLE A m)

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.symmetrizedDeriv_mem_adjoin_symbolsLE
declarations.doc:
A symmetrized symbol with `r` derivatives is a polynomial in the symbols with fewer
than `r` derivatives.
declarations.statement:
lemma symmetrizedDeriv_mem_adjoin_symbolsLE (r : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) :
    symmetrizedDeriv r A φ ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℂ (symbolsLE A (r.card - 1))

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.bracketFam_mem_adjoin_symbols
declarations.doc:
The bracket of two component families whose components are order-`n` symbol
polynomials is again an order-`n` symbol polynomial, componentwise.
declarations.statement:
lemma bracketFam_mem_adjoin_symbols {n : ℕ} {f g : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra →ₗ[ℝ] B}
    (hf : ∀ ψ, f ψ ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℂ (symbolsLE A n))
    (hg : ∀ ψ, g ψ ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℂ (symbolsLE A n)) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) :
    bracketFam f g φ ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℂ (symbolsLE A n)

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.fieldStrength_mem_adjoin_symbols
declarations.doc:
Every derivative symbol of the field strength is a symbol polynomial of order
one higher than the number of derivatives.
declarations.statement:
lemma fieldStrength_mem_adjoin_symbols (q : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (ν lam : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) :
    fieldStrength A ν lam q φ ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℂ (symbolsLE A (q.card + 1))

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.iteratedCovDerivAdjoint_sub_mem
declarations.doc:
Unitriangularity of the covariant tower. The covariant and plain derivative symbols of
the field strength differ by a polynomial in lower-order symbols. Stated at every
derivative multiset `s`, as needed for the induction, since the covariant derivative shifts
the family index.
declarations.statement:
lemma iteratedCovDerivAdjoint_sub_mem (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (ν lam : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) :
    iteratedCovDerivAdjoint A l (fieldStrength A ν lam) s φ -
        fieldStrength A ν lam (Multiset.ofList l + s) φ ∈
      Algebra.adjoin ℂ (symbolsLE A (l.length + s.card))

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.iteratedCovDerivAdjoint_fieldStrength_mem_adjoin_symbols
declarations.doc:
The underived covariant field-strength tower consists of polynomials in the
gauge-field symbols.
declarations.statement:
lemma iteratedCovDerivAdjoint_fieldStrength_mem_adjoin_symbols
    (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (ν lam : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) :
    iteratedCovDerivAdjoint A l (fieldStrength A ν lam) 0 φ ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℂ (symbols A)

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.symbol_mem_symFieldAdjoin_sup
declarations.doc:
The inductive step of the generation theorem. Every derivative symbol of order `n + 1`
lies in the subalgebra generated by its symmetrization, the covariant derivatives of the
field strength of order `n`, and the symbols of order at most `n`.
declarations.statement:
lemma symbol_mem_symFieldAdjoin_sup (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) :
    A s μ φ ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℂ (symSymbolsLE A (s.card + 1) ∪ towerLT A s.card) ⊔
      Algebra.adjoin ℂ (symbolsLE A (s.card - 1))

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.symbolAdjoin_eq_symFieldAdjoin
declarations.doc:
The generation theorem, by strong induction on the order. The derivative symbols of
order at most `n` and the symmetrized symbols together with the covariant field-strength
tower generate the same subalgebra,

`adjoin({ ∂_p A : |p| ≤ n }) = adjoin({ sym(∂_p A) : |p| ≤ n + 1 } ∪ { 𝒟_q F : |q| < n })`.
declarations.statement:
lemma symbolAdjoin_eq_symFieldAdjoin (n : ℕ) :
    Algebra.adjoin ℂ (symbolsLE A n) =
      Algebra.adjoin ℂ (symSymbolsLE A (n + 1) ∪ towerLT A n)

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.symbolAdjoin_union_eq_symFieldAdjoin_union
declarations.doc: The generation theorem relativized to an arbitrary set `S` of extra generators.
declarations.statement:
lemma symbolAdjoin_union_eq_symFieldAdjoin_union (n : ℕ) (S : Set B) :
    Algebra.adjoin ℂ (symbolsLE A n ∪ S) =
      Algebra.adjoin ℂ ((symSymbolsLE A (n + 1) ∪ towerLT A n) ∪ S)

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.exists_le_of_mem_adjoin_symbols_union
declarations.doc:
Finite order bound. Membership in the subalgebra generated by all symbols and `S`
uses only finitely many generators, hence symbols of some bounded order.

modules.title: The gauge-boson field of a gauge theory
modules.doc:
The target space of the gauge bosons, a spacetime covector with values in the gauge algebra.

## i. Overview

The gauge bosons of a gauge theory with Lie algebra `G.lieSubalgebra` are jointly one bosonic field
valued in `Lorentz.CoVector ⊗[ℝ] G.lieSubalgebra`, a spacetime covector with values in the gauge
algebra. Its components are the fields `A_μ^a`, but no basis of the gauge algebra is
chosen. The adjoint index is carried by an abstract covector `φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra`
throughout.

This file is the target space alone, with its linear structure, the Lorentz action, the
global gauge action, and the field-derivative space spanned by the component functions
`∂_s A_μ^φ`. The jet algebra built on it, and the actions and gradings it carries, are in the
directory
`PhyslibAlpha/ClassicalFieldTheory/GaugeTheory/GaugeBoson/LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra`. For the Standard
Model, `G.lieSubalgebra` is `StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra`.

## ii. Key results

- `GaugeBoson` : the target space of the gauge-boson field.
- `GaugeBoson.repLorentzGroup` : the Lorentz action on the target space.
- `GaugeBoson.repValue` : the global gauge action on the target space, from a
  representation of the value group.
- `GaugeBoson.FieldDerivSpace` : the span of the component functions `∂_s A_μ^φ`.
- `GaugeBoson.componentDual` : the covector picking out a spacetime and an adjoint index.
- `GaugeBoson.dual_eq_sum_componentDual` : every covector on the target space is a sum of
  component covectors.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The target space of the gauge-boson field
  - A.1. Linear structure
  - A.2. The Lorentz action on the target space
  - A.3. The global gauge action on the target space
- B. The field-derivative space
  - B.1. The component covectors

## iv. References

* None.

sections.text: ## A. The target space of the gauge-boson field
### A.1. Linear structure
### A.2. The Lorentz action on the target space
### A.3. The global gauge action on the target space
## B. The field-derivative space
### B.1. The component covectors

declarations.name: GaugeBoson
declarations.doc:
The target vector space of the gauge-boson field, a spacetime covector
with values in the gauge algebra. Its components are the fields `A_μ^a`, and here the
adjoint index is kept abstract, as the gauge-algebra factor.
declarations.statement:
structure GaugeBoson where
  /-- The underlying covector-valued gauge algebra element. -/
  val : Lorentz.CoVector ⊗[ℝ] G.lieSubalgebra

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.valEquiv
declarations.doc: Identifies a gauge boson with its underlying tensor-product value.
declarations.statement: def valEquiv : (GaugeBoson G) ≃ Lorentz.CoVector ⊗[ℝ] G.lieSubalgebra
noncomputable instance : AddCommGroup (GaugeBoson G)
noncomputable instance : Module ℝ (GaugeBoson G)

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.valLinEquiv
declarations.doc: The linear identification with the underlying tensor product.
declarations.statement: def valLinEquiv : (GaugeBoson G) ≃ₗ[ℝ] Lorentz.CoVector ⊗[ℝ] G.lieSubalgebra

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.valLinEquiv_apply
declarations.statement: lemma valLinEquiv_apply (v : (GaugeBoson G)) : (valLinEquiv G) v = v.val

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.valLinEquiv_symm_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma valLinEquiv_symm_apply (m : Lorentz.CoVector ⊗[ℝ] G.lieSubalgebra) :
    (valLinEquiv G).symm m = ⟨m⟩

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.val_add
declarations.statement: lemma val_add (v₁ v₂ : (GaugeBoson G)) : (v₁ + v₂).val = v₁.val + v₂.val

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.val_smul
declarations.statement: lemma val_smul (r : ℝ) (v : (GaugeBoson G)) : (r • v).val = r • v.val
instance : Module.Finite ℝ (GaugeBoson G)

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.repLorentzGroup
declarations.doc:
The Lorentz action on the gauge-boson target space, the covector action on the
spacetime index and the trivial action on the gauge-algebra factor.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def repLorentzGroup : Representation ℝ SL(2,ℂ) (GaugeBoson G)

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.repValue
declarations.doc:
The global gauge action on the gauge-boson target space, the given action on the
gauge-algebra factor and the trivial action on the spacetime index.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def repValue {G₀ : Type} [Monoid G₀] (ρ : Representation ℝ G₀ G.lieSubalgebra) :
    Representation ℝ G₀ (GaugeBoson G)

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.FieldDerivSpace
declarations.doc:
The field-derivative space of the gauge-boson field, the span of the component functions
`∂_s A_μ^φ`. The `SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ` factor carries the derivative label `s`, and the
dual factor the spacetime and adjoint indices, the latter as an abstract covector on
the gauge algebra with no basis chosen. Unlike a matter field, the gauge boson is real,
so there is no conjugate half.
declarations.statement: abbrev FieldDerivSpace : Type

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.componentDual
declarations.doc:
The covector on the gauge-boson target space pairing the spacetime index against a
covector `ω` and the adjoint index against `φ`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def componentDual :
    Module.Dual ℝ Lorentz.CoVector →ₗ[ℝ]
      Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra →ₗ[ℝ] Module.Dual ℝ (GaugeBoson G)

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.componentDual_apply_val_tmul
declarations.statement:
lemma componentDual_apply_val_tmul (ω : Module.Dual ℝ Lorentz.CoVector)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) (v : Lorentz.CoVector) (a : G.lieSubalgebra) :
    (componentDual G) ω φ ⟨v ⊗ₜ[ℝ] a⟩ = ω v * φ a

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.dual_eq_sum_componentDual
declarations.doc:
Every covector on the gauge-boson target space decomposes along the Lorentz coordinate
directions into component covectors. The spacetime index is expanded in the coordinate
basis, while the adjoint index stays abstract.
declarations.statement:
lemma dual_eq_sum_componentDual
    (ψ : Module.Dual ℝ (GaugeBoson G)) :
    ψ = ∑ μ, (GaugeBoson.componentDual G) (Lorentz.CoVector.basis.dualBasis μ)
      (ψ ∘ₗ (GaugeBoson.valLinEquiv G).symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        TensorProduct.mk ℝ Lorentz.CoVector G.lieSubalgebra (Lorentz.CoVector.basis μ))

modules.title: The local gauge field algebra of a gauge theory
modules.doc:
The jet algebra of the gauge bosons, generated by the component functions `∂_s A_μ^φ`.

## i. Overview

The gauge bosons of a gauge theory with Lie algebra `G.lieSubalgebra` are jointly one bosonic field
valued in `Lorentz.CoVector ⊗[ℝ] G.lieSubalgebra`, the target space `GaugeBoson G` of
`PhyslibAlpha.ClassicalFieldTheory.GaugeTheory.GaugeBoson.Basic`. Its *local gauge field
algebra* `LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra G`, the jet algebra in which the gauge-boson part of a
Lagrangian lives, is the free commutative algebra on the component functions `∂_s A_μ^φ`. No
basis of the gauge algebra is chosen. The adjoint index is carried by an abstract covector
`φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra` throughout, following the dual-family formulation of the
adjoint families in the directory
`PhyslibAlpha/ClassicalFieldTheory/GaugeTheory/GaugeBoson/AdjointFamily`.
For the Standard Model, `G.lieSubalgebra` is `StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra`.

The files of this directory are the following.
1. This file gives the jet algebra with its generators, over the target space and the
   field-derivative space of `GaugeBoson.Basic`.
2. `LorentzAction` gives the action of the Lorentz group.
3. `GaugeAction` gives the action of the jet gauge group.
4. `JetDeriv` gives the formal total derivative.
5. `MassDim` and `MassWeightPoly` give the mass-dimension grading.
6. `GaugeField` gives the gauge-field symbols and their laws.
7. `FieldStrength` gives the field strength and its covariant derivatives.

## ii. Key results

- `LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra` : the local gauge field algebra, the jet algebra of the gauge
  bosons.
- `LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.ofComponent`, `LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.ofA` : the generators.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The jet algebra
  - A.1. The generators

## iv. References

* None.

sections.text: ## A. The jet algebra
### A.1. The generators

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra
declarations.doc:
The local gauge field algebra, the jet algebra of the gauge bosons. It is the free
commutative algebra on the component functions `∂_s A_μ^φ` of the gauge-boson field,
realized as the symmetric algebra on the field-derivative space. The commutativity of the
product is the Bose statistics of the gauge fields.
declarations.statement: abbrev LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra : Type

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.ofComponent
declarations.doc:
The undifferentiated component function `A^φ` of the gauge-boson field along a
covector `φ` on the target space.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def ofComponent : Module.Dual ℝ (GaugeBoson G) →ₗ[ℝ] (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra G)

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.ofComponent_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma ofComponent_apply (φ : Module.Dual ℝ (GaugeBoson G)) :
    (ofComponent G) φ = SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℝ _ ((1 : SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ) ⊗ₜ[ℝ] φ)

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.ofA
declarations.doc:
The component function `A_μ^φ` of the gauge-boson field, with the spacetime index `μ`
paired against the Lorentz coordinate basis and the adjoint index against the abstract
covector `φ` on the gauge algebra. These are the generators the ambient theory sees, and
no basis of the gauge algebra is involved.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def ofA (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra →ₗ[ℝ] (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra G)

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.ofA_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma ofA_apply (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) :
    (ofA G) μ φ = (ofComponent G) ((GaugeBoson.componentDual G)
      (Lorentz.CoVector.basis.dualBasis μ) φ)

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.adjoin_ι_eq_top
declarations.doc: The jet algebra is generated by the component functions.
declarations.statement:
lemma adjoin_ι_eq_top :
    Algebra.adjoin ℝ (Set.range (SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℝ (GaugeBoson.FieldDerivSpace G))) = ⊤

modules.title: The field strength in the local gauge field algebra
modules.doc:
The field strength `F_μν` of the gauge bosons and its covariant derivatives, with their gauge
and Lorentz laws.

## i. Overview

The field strength and its covariant derivatives are built for an arbitrary family of
gauge-field symbols in an arbitrary algebra in the directory
`PhyslibAlpha/ClassicalFieldTheory/GaugeTheory/GaugeBoson/AdjointFamily`, as
families of derivative symbols. Here they are
specialized to the real algebra `LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra G` itself, whose symbols are its
own generators `∂_s A_μ^φ` (`derivA`).

Two facts make the specialization work. The symbols that the families carry are honest
iterated derivatives of their base values
(`iteratedCovDerivAdjoint_fieldStrength_derivA`), which turns the symbol-level recursion
of `iteratedCovDerivAdjoint` into the recursion `covDerivFieldStrength_cons` on elements
of the algebra. And the gauge law is not reproved: the complexified tower is the image of
the real one under `x ↦ 1 ⊗ₜ x`, which is injective and intertwines the two gauge actions,
so the law of the complexified symbols descends. The Lorentz law is proved directly from
the recursion.

Everything here is over `ℝ`. The complexification `ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra G`
appears only as that bridge, and it is never identified with the real algebra.

## ii. Key results

- `LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.fieldStrength`, `LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.covDerivFieldStrength` :
  the field strength `F_μν^φ` and its ordered covariant derivatives `∇_l F_μν^φ`.
- `LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repJet_covDerivFieldStrength_eval` : the gauge law, through the
  value of the jet alone.
- `LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_covDerivFieldStrength` : the Lorentz law.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The derivative symbols of the real algebra
- B. The field strength and its covariant derivatives
- C. The derivative symbols of the covariant tower are iterated derivatives
- D. The gauge law, by descent from the complexification
- E. The Lorentz law

## iv. References

* None.

sections.text: ## A. The derivative symbols of the real algebra
## B. The field strength and its covariant derivatives

## C. The derivative symbols of the covariant tower are iterated derivatives

The adjoint families carry the derivative symbols `∂_s F` of a
covariant expression as data. Here the Leibniz convolutions defining the derived brackets
really are the Leibniz rule of the total derivative, so those symbols are the iterated
total derivatives `∂_s` of the value at `0`.

## D. The gauge law, by descent from the complexification

The gauge law is proved in
`PhyslibAlpha.ClassicalFieldTheory.GaugeTheory.GaugeBoson.AdjointFamily.GaugeLaw` for any
family transforming as a gauge field in a complex algebra, such as the symbols of the
complexification (`transformsAsGaugeField_gaugeField`). Injectivity of `x ↦ 1 ⊗ₜ x` reads the
real law off the complex one, and no reality argument beyond that is involved.
## E. The Lorentz law

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.derivA
declarations.doc:
The derivative symbols `∂_s A_μ^φ` of the local gauge field algebra, as a family over
the derivative multiset `s` and the spacetime index `μ`, the iterated total derivative of
the gauge-field generator. The field strength and its covariant derivatives are built
out of this family.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def derivA (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra →ₗ[ℝ] LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra G

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.derivA_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma derivA_apply (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) : derivA G s μ φ = iteratedJetDeriv G s (ofA G μ φ)

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.derivA_zero
declarations.statement: lemma derivA_zero (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) : derivA G 0 μ = ofA G μ

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.gaugeField_eq_one_tmul_derivA
declarations.doc: The complexified symbols `gaugeField` are the images of the real symbols.
declarations.statement:
lemma gaugeField_eq_one_tmul_derivA (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) : gaugeField G s μ φ = (1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℝ] derivA G s μ φ

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.algHom_ext
declarations.doc:
Two algebra maps out of the local gauge field algebra agreeing on the derivative
symbols `∂_s A_μ^φ` are equal.

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.fieldStrength
declarations.doc:
The field strength `F_μν = ∂_μ A_ν − ∂_ν A_μ + ⁅A_μ, A_ν⁆` of the local gauge field
algebra, the underived field strength of the family of derivative symbols, in the
conventions of `GaugeBoson.fieldStrength`, where the bracket of the gauge
algebra carries the physicists' factor of `i`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def fieldStrength (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra →ₗ[ℝ] LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra G

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.fieldStrength_apply
declarations.doc: The field strength written in the generators of the algebra.
declarations.statement:
lemma fieldStrength_apply (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) :
    fieldStrength G μ ν φ = jetDeriv G μ (ofA G ν φ) - jetDeriv G ν (ofA G μ φ)
      + bracketFam (ofA G μ) (ofA G ν) φ

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.fieldStrength_swap
declarations.doc: The field strength is antisymmetric in its two covector indices.
declarations.statement:
lemma fieldStrength_swap (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    fieldStrength G ν μ = - fieldStrength G μ ν

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.covDerivFieldStrength
declarations.doc:
The iterated covariant derivative `∇_{l₁} ⋯ ∇_{lₙ} F_μν` of the field strength along an
ordered list of directions, with `∇_ρ F = ∂_ρ F + ⁅A_ρ, F⁆` the covariant derivative in
the adjoint. Covariant derivatives do not commute, so the iteration is indexed by a list
and not by a multiset; the empty list gives the field strength itself.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def covDerivFieldStrength (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra →ₗ[ℝ] LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra G

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.covDerivFieldStrength_nil
declarations.doc: With zero covariant derivatives this is the field strength itself.
declarations.statement:
lemma covDerivFieldStrength_nil (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    covDerivFieldStrength G [] μ ν = fieldStrength G μ ν

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.iteratedJetDeriv_bracketFam
declarations.doc:
The Leibniz rule of the iterated total derivative on a bracket of families, as the
antidiagonal convolution of the iterated derivatives of the two factors.
declarations.statement:
lemma iteratedJetDeriv_bracketFam (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (f g : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra →ₗ[ℝ] LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra G)
      (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) :
    iteratedJetDeriv G s (bracketFam f g φ) = (s.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
      bracketFam (iteratedJetDeriv G p.1 ∘ₗ f) (iteratedJetDeriv G p.2 ∘ₗ g) φ).sum

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.bracketFamConv_derivA
declarations.doc:
If a family consists of the iterated derivatives of its base value, so does its derived
bracket against the gauge field. The Leibniz convolution is the iterated derivative of the
bracket of the base values.
declarations.statement:
lemma bracketFamConv_derivA (F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra →ₗ[ℝ]
    LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra G)
    (hF : ∀ (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra),
      F s φ = iteratedJetDeriv G s (F 0 φ))
    (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) :
    bracketFamConv (derivA G) ρ F s φ
      = iteratedJetDeriv G s (bracketFam (ofA G ρ) (F 0) φ)

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.covDerivAdjoint_derivA
declarations.doc:
The covariant derivative of a family of iterated derivatives is again a family of
iterated derivatives.
declarations.statement:
lemma covDerivAdjoint_derivA (F : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) → Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra →ₗ[ℝ]
    LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra G)
    (hF : ∀ (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra),
      F s φ = iteratedJetDeriv G s (F 0 φ))
    (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) :
    covDerivAdjoint (derivA G) F ρ s φ
      = iteratedJetDeriv G s (covDerivAdjoint (derivA G) F ρ 0 φ)

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.fieldStrength_derivA
declarations.doc:
The derivative symbols of the field strength are the iterated derivatives of the field
strength.
declarations.statement:
lemma fieldStrength_derivA (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) :
    GaugeBoson.fieldStrength (derivA G) μ ν s φ
      = iteratedJetDeriv G s (fieldStrength G μ ν φ)

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.iteratedCovDerivAdjoint_fieldStrength_derivA
declarations.doc:
The derivative symbols of the covariant derivatives of the field strength are the
iterated derivatives of their base values.
declarations.statement:
lemma iteratedCovDerivAdjoint_fieldStrength_derivA (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) :
    iteratedCovDerivAdjoint (derivA G) l (GaugeBoson.fieldStrength (derivA G) μ ν)
        s φ
      = iteratedJetDeriv G s (covDerivFieldStrength G l μ ν φ)

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.covDerivFieldStrength_cons
declarations.doc:
The covariant derivative `∇_ρ F = ∂_ρ F + ⁅A_ρ, F⁆` peeled off the front of the list,
giving the recursion on elements of the algebra.
declarations.statement:
lemma covDerivFieldStrength_cons (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) :
    covDerivFieldStrength G (ρ :: l) μ ν φ
      = jetDeriv G ρ (covDerivFieldStrength G l μ ν φ)
        + bracketFam (ofA G ρ) (covDerivFieldStrength G l μ ν) φ

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.one_tmul_iteratedCovDerivAdjoint_fieldStrength
declarations.doc:
The complexified covariant tower is the image of the real
one.
declarations.statement:
lemma one_tmul_iteratedCovDerivAdjoint_fieldStrength (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) :
    (1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℝ] iteratedCovDerivAdjoint (derivA G) l
        (GaugeBoson.fieldStrength (derivA G) μ ν) s φ
      = iteratedCovDerivAdjoint (gaugeField G) l
        (GaugeBoson.fieldStrength (gaugeField G) μ ν) s φ

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repJet_iteratedCovDerivAdjoint_fieldStrength
declarations.doc:
The gauge law of the covariant derivatives of the field strength at every derivative
order. A jet acts by the Leibniz convolution of the dual adjoint Taylor coefficients of
`U⁻¹` against lower derivative symbols, with no Maurer–Cartan shift.
declarations.statement:
lemma repJet_iteratedCovDerivAdjoint_fieldStrength (U : G.gaugeJetGroup) (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) :
    repJet G U (iteratedCovDerivAdjoint (derivA G) l
        (GaugeBoson.fieldStrength (derivA G) μ ν) s φ)
      = (s.antidiagonal.map fun p => iteratedCovDerivAdjoint (derivA G) l
          (GaugeBoson.fieldStrength (derivA G) μ ν) p.2
          (G.adjointDualCoeff U⁻¹ p.1 φ)).sum

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repJet_covDerivFieldStrength
declarations.doc:
The gauge law of the covariant derivatives of the field strength. A jet acts through
the zeroth dual adjoint Taylor coefficient of `U⁻¹` on the adjoint index alone.
declarations.statement:
lemma repJet_covDerivFieldStrength (U : G.gaugeJetGroup) (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) :
    repJet G U (covDerivFieldStrength G l μ ν φ)
      = covDerivFieldStrength G l μ ν (G.adjointDualCoeff U⁻¹ 0 φ)

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repJet_covDerivFieldStrength_eval
declarations.doc:
On the covariant derivatives of the field strength the local gauge action factors
through evaluation. A jet `U` acts through the dual base-point adjoint action of the
value `G.evalGaugeJet U⁻¹` of its inverse, and the derivatives of the jet are not seen. The
covariant expressions are gauge covariant, not gauge invariant.
declarations.statement:
lemma repJet_covDerivFieldStrength_eval (U : G.gaugeJetGroup) (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) :
    repJet G U (covDerivFieldStrength G l μ ν φ)
      = covDerivFieldStrength G l μ ν ((G.adjointRep
        (G.evalGaugeJet U⁻¹)).dualMap φ)

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_comp_ofA
declarations.doc: The Lorentz action on the gauge-field generator, as a linear map.
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_comp_ofA (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    (repLorentzGroup G Λ) ∘ₗ ofA G μ = ∑ a, L[Λ] a μ • ofA G a

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_bracketFam_ofA
declarations.doc:
The Lorentz action passes through the bracket of a gauge-field generator against a
family, mixing the covector index of the generator.
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_bracketFam_ofA (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (ρ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (F : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra →ₗ[ℝ] LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra G)
      (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) :
    repLorentzGroup G Λ (bracketFam (ofA G ρ) F φ)
      = ∑ a, L[Λ] a ρ • bracketFam (ofA G a) ((repLorentzGroup G Λ) ∘ₗ F) φ

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_fieldStrength
declarations.doc:
The Lorentz law of the field strength. Both covector indices mix by the columns of the
Lorentz matrix, and the adjoint index is untouched.
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_fieldStrength (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) :
    repLorentzGroup G Λ (fieldStrength G μ ν φ)
      = ∑ a, L[Λ] a μ • ∑ b, L[Λ] b ν • fieldStrength G a b φ

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_covDerivFieldStrength
declarations.doc:
The Lorentz law of the covariant derivatives of the field strength. Every covariant
slot and both covector indices of the field strength mix by the columns of the Lorentz
matrix, and the adjoint index is untouched.
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_covDerivFieldStrength (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) {n : ℕ}
    (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) :
    repLorentzGroup G Λ (covDerivFieldStrength G (List.ofFn l) μ ν φ)
      = ∑ p : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), (∏ i, L[Λ] (p i) (l i)) •
          ∑ a, L[Λ] a μ • ∑ b, L[Λ] b ν • covDerivFieldStrength G (List.ofFn p) a b φ

modules.title: The gauge action on the gauge-boson jet algebra
modules.doc:
The affine action of the gauge jets on the gauge field, extended to its jet algebra.

## i. Overview

A jet of gauge transformations `U` acts on the gauge field by
`A_μ ↦ Ad_U A_μ + maurerCartan(U)_μ`, so on a component function `∂_s A_μ^φ` it acts affinely.
The linear part is the all-orders Leibniz convolution of the Taylor coefficients of `Ad(U⁻¹)`
against lower component functions, and the constant part is the Taylor coefficient of the
Maurer–Cartan form of `U⁻¹`. The action extends to the whole jet algebra as the
substitution homomorphism determined by this affine action on the generators.

The linear part is built from the adjoint Taylor coefficients `GlobalGaugeGroup.adjointCoeff` of
the gauge group, whose multiplicativity up to convolution is the Taylor–Leibniz theorem
`GlobalGaugeGroup.evalLie_iteratedDerivJ_adjointJ`. It makes the transport
multiplicative and gives the cocycle identity for the Maurer–Cartan shift.

## ii. Key results

- `GaugeBoson.adjointTransport` : the adjoint Taylor coefficients on the target space.
- `LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.transport` : the linear part of the gauge action on the component
  space.
- `LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.maurerCartanShift` : the Maurer–Cartan shift.
- `LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repJet` : the action of the jet gauge group on the jet algebra.
- `LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repJet_iteratedJetDeriv_ofA` : the transformation law of the derivative
  generators.
- `LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexRepJet` : the action on the complexified jet algebra.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The transport on the component space
- B. The Maurer–Cartan shift
- C. The action of the jet gauge group
  - C.1. The transformation law of the generators
  - C.2. The complexified action

## iv. References

* None.

### C.2. The complexified action

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.adjointTransport
declarations.doc:
The adjoint transport on the gauge-boson target space at `p` derivatives, the adjoint
Taylor coefficient on the gauge-algebra factor, the identity on the spacetime index.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def adjointTransport (U : G.gaugeJetGroup) (p : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    (GaugeBoson G) →ₗ[ℝ] (GaugeBoson G)

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.adjointTransport_mk_tmul
declarations.statement:
lemma adjointTransport_mk_tmul (U : G.gaugeJetGroup) (p : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (v : Lorentz.CoVector) (a : G.lieSubalgebra) :
    adjointTransport G U p ⟨v ⊗ₜ[ℝ] a⟩ = ⟨v ⊗ₜ[ℝ] G.adjointCoeff U p a⟩

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.adjointTransport_one
declarations.doc: The adjoint transport at the identity. Only the base point survives.
declarations.statement:
lemma adjointTransport_one (p : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    adjointTransport G 1 p = if p = 0 then LinearMap.id else 0

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.adjointTransport_mul
declarations.doc: The adjoint transport of a product is the antidiagonal convolution of transports.
declarations.statement:
lemma adjointTransport_mul (U V : G.gaugeJetGroup) (p : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    adjointTransport G (U * V) p
      = (p.antidiagonal.map fun r =>
          adjointTransport G U r.1 ∘ₗ adjointTransport G V r.2).sum

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.dualMap_adjointTransport_componentDual
declarations.doc:
The dual transport carries a component covector to the component covector of the
transported adjoint index. The spacetime slot is untouched.
declarations.statement:
lemma dualMap_adjointTransport_componentDual (U : G.gaugeJetGroup)
    (p : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (ω : Module.Dual ℝ Lorentz.CoVector)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) :
    (adjointTransport G U p).dualMap ((componentDual G) ω φ)
      = (componentDual G) ω (φ ∘ₗ G.adjointCoeff U p)

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.transportFun
declarations.doc:
The value of the transport on the derivative symbol at `s`, the all-orders Leibniz
convolution of the dual adjoint transports against lower derivative symbols.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def transportFun (U : G.gaugeJetGroup) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    Module.Dual ℝ (GaugeBoson G) →ₗ[ℝ] (GaugeBoson.FieldDerivSpace G)

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.transport
declarations.doc:
The linear part of the gauge action on the field-derivative space. On a component
function `∂_s A^ψ` it is the all-orders Leibniz convolution of the Taylor coefficients
of the adjoint action of `U` against the lower component functions.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def transport (U : G.gaugeJetGroup) :
    (GaugeBoson.FieldDerivSpace G) →ₗ[ℝ] (GaugeBoson.FieldDerivSpace G)

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.transport_basis_tmul
declarations.statement:
lemma transport_basis_tmul (U : G.gaugeJetGroup) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (ψ : Module.Dual ℝ (GaugeBoson G)) :
    transport G U (SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.basisMultiset s ⊗ₜ[ℝ] ψ)
      = (s.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
          SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.basisMultiset p.2 ⊗ₜ[ℝ]
            (GaugeBoson.adjointTransport G U p.1).dualMap ψ).sum

declarations.name: GaugeBoson.FieldDerivSpace.ext_of_basis
declarations.doc:
Two maps out of the field-derivative space agree if they agree on the components
`∂_s A^ψ` with `s` a derivative multiset and `ψ` an arbitrary covector.
declarations.statement:
lemma _root_.GaugeBoson.FieldDerivSpace.ext_of_basis
    {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module ℝ M]
    {F₁ F₂ : (GaugeBoson.FieldDerivSpace G) →ₗ[ℝ] M}
    (h : ∀ (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (ψ : Module.Dual ℝ (GaugeBoson G)),
      F₁ (SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.basisMultiset s ⊗ₜ[ℝ] ψ)
        = F₂ (SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.basisMultiset s ⊗ₜ[ℝ] ψ)) : F₁ = F₂

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.transport_one
declarations.doc: The transport of the identity is the identity.
declarations.statement: lemma transport_one : transport G (1 : G.gaugeJetGroup) = LinearMap.id

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.transport_mul
declarations.doc:
The transport is an anti-homomorphism. The transport of a product is the reverse
composite. Composed with the inverse, it becomes the linear part of the gauge
representation.
declarations.statement:
lemma transport_mul (U V : G.gaugeJetGroup) :
    transport G (U * V) = transport G V ∘ₗ transport G U

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.maurerCartanBosonCoeff
declarations.doc:
The Taylor coefficient of the Maurer–Cartan form of `U` at the derivative multiset
`s`, packaged as a gauge boson. The spacetime index runs over the coordinate
directions, and the adjoint index over the base-point Taylor coefficients of the
Maurer–Cartan form.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def maurerCartanBosonCoeff (U : G.gaugeJetGroup) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    (GaugeBoson G)

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.maurerCartanBosonCoeff_one
declarations.statement:
lemma maurerCartanBosonCoeff_one (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    maurerCartanBosonCoeff G 1 s = 0

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.maurerCartanBosonCoeff_mul
declarations.doc:
The Maurer–Cartan Taylor coefficients of a product, given by the cocycle identity with the
adjoint transport convoluted in by the Taylor–Leibniz theorem.
declarations.statement:
lemma maurerCartanBosonCoeff_mul (U V : G.gaugeJetGroup) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    maurerCartanBosonCoeff G (U * V) s
      = maurerCartanBosonCoeff G U s
        + (s.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
            GaugeBoson.adjointTransport G U p.1 (maurerCartanBosonCoeff G V p.2)).sum

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.maurerCartanShift
declarations.doc:
The Maurer–Cartan shift, the linear functional on the component space pairing a
component `∂_s A^ψ` with the Taylor coefficient of the Maurer–Cartan form of `U`. It is
the constant part of the affine gauge action.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def maurerCartanShift (U : G.gaugeJetGroup) :
    (GaugeBoson.FieldDerivSpace G) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.maurerCartanShift_basis_tmul
declarations.statement:
lemma maurerCartanShift_basis_tmul (U : G.gaugeJetGroup) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (ψ : Module.Dual ℝ (GaugeBoson G)) :
    maurerCartanShift G U (SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ.basisMultiset s ⊗ₜ[ℝ] ψ)
      = ψ (maurerCartanBosonCoeff G U s)

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.maurerCartanShift_one
declarations.statement: lemma maurerCartanShift_one : maurerCartanShift G (1 : G.gaugeJetGroup) = 0

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.maurerCartanShift_mul
declarations.doc: The cocycle identity for the Maurer–Cartan shift.
declarations.statement:
lemma maurerCartanShift_mul (U V : G.gaugeJetGroup) :
    maurerCartanShift G (U * V) =
      maurerCartanShift G V ∘ₗ transport G U + maurerCartanShift G U

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.gaugeGeneratorMap
declarations.doc:
The affine action of a jet of gauge transformations on the generators of the jet
algebra, the transported component plus the Maurer–Cartan shift, both of `U⁻¹` — the
contragredient convention for an action on component functions.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def gaugeGeneratorMap (U : G.gaugeJetGroup) :
    (GaugeBoson.FieldDerivSpace G) →ₗ[ℝ] (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra G)

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.gaugeGeneratorMap_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma gaugeGeneratorMap_apply (U : G.gaugeJetGroup) (x : (GaugeBoson.FieldDerivSpace G)) :
    gaugeGeneratorMap G U x = SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℝ _ (transport G U⁻¹ x)
      + algebraMap ℝ (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra G) (maurerCartanShift G U⁻¹ x)

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repJet
declarations.doc:
The action of the jet gauge group on the gauge-boson jet algebra, the substitution
homomorphism determined by the affine action on the generators, `∂_s A^ψ` going to its
transported convolution plus the Maurer–Cartan shift of `U⁻¹`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def repJet : Representation ℝ G.gaugeJetGroup (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra G)

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repJetAlgHom
declarations.doc:
The action of `U` as an algebra homomorphism. A jet of gauge transformations acts on
a Lagrangian term factor by factor.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def repJetAlgHom (U : G.gaugeJetGroup) :
    (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra G) →ₐ[ℝ] (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra G)

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repJet_ι
declarations.statement:
lemma repJet_ι (U : G.gaugeJetGroup) (x : (GaugeBoson.FieldDerivSpace G)) :
    repJet G U (SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℝ _ x)
      = SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℝ _ (transport G U⁻¹ x)
        + algebraMap ℝ (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra G) (maurerCartanShift G U⁻¹ x)

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repJet_apply_one
declarations.statement:
lemma repJet_apply_one (U : G.gaugeJetGroup) :
    repJet G U (1 : (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra G)) = 1

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repJet_apply_mul
declarations.statement:
lemma repJet_apply_mul (U : G.gaugeJetGroup) (x y : (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra G)) :
    repJet G U (x * y) = repJet G U x * repJet G U y

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repJet_algebraMap
declarations.statement:
lemma repJet_algebraMap (U : G.gaugeJetGroup) (r : ℝ) :
    repJet G U (algebraMap ℝ (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra G) r)
      = algebraMap ℝ (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra G) r

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.componentDual_dualBasis_maurerCartanBosonCoeff
declarations.doc:
The component covector at `μ` picks the `μ`-th Maurer–Cartan Taylor coefficient out
of the shift.
declarations.statement:
lemma componentDual_dualBasis_maurerCartanBosonCoeff (W : G.gaugeJetGroup)
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) :
    (GaugeBoson.componentDual G) (Lorentz.CoVector.basis.dualBasis μ) φ
        (maurerCartanBosonCoeff G W s)
      = φ (G.evalLie (G.iteratedDerivJ s
          (-G.maurerCartan W μ)))

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repJet_iteratedJetDeriv_ofA
declarations.doc:
The transformation law of the derivative generators. A jet of gauge transformations acts on
`∂_s A_μ^φ` by the all-orders
Leibniz convolution of the adjoint Taylor coefficients of `U⁻¹` against lower
generators, plus the Taylor coefficient of the Maurer–Cartan form of `U⁻¹`.
declarations.statement:
lemma repJet_iteratedJetDeriv_ofA (U : G.gaugeJetGroup)
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) :
    repJet G U ((iteratedJetDeriv G) s ((ofA G) μ φ))
      = (s.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
          (iteratedJetDeriv G) p.2 ((ofA G) μ (G.adjointDualCoeff U⁻¹ p.1 φ))).sum
        + algebraMap ℝ (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra G)
            (φ (G.evalLie (G.iteratedDerivJ s
              (-G.maurerCartan U⁻¹ μ))))

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexRepJet
declarations.doc:
The action of the jet gauge group on the complexified gauge-boson jet algebra, by
base change.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def complexRepJet :
    Representation ℂ G.gaugeJetGroup (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra G))

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexRepJet_tmul
declarations.statement:
lemma complexRepJet_tmul (U : G.gaugeJetGroup) (z : ℂ) (x : (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra G)) :
    complexRepJet G U (z ⊗ₜ[ℝ] x) = z ⊗ₜ[ℝ] repJet G U x

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexRepJetAlgHom
declarations.doc:
The action of a jet on the complexified gauge-boson jet algebra, as an algebra
endomorphism, the base change of `repJetAlgHom`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def complexRepJetAlgHom (U : G.gaugeJetGroup) :
    ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra G) →ₐ[ℂ] ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra G)

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexRepJet_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma complexRepJet_apply (U : G.gaugeJetGroup) (x : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra G)) :
    complexRepJet G U x = complexRepJetAlgHom G U x

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexRepJet_apply_mul
declarations.statement:
lemma complexRepJet_apply_mul (U : G.gaugeJetGroup)
    (x y : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra G)) :
    complexRepJet G U (x * y)
      = complexRepJet G U x * complexRepJet G U y

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.iteratedD_complexJetDeriv_one_tmul
declarations.doc:
The iterated complexified derivative of a real element is the complexification of the
iterated real derivative.
declarations.statement:
lemma iteratedD_complexJetDeriv_one_tmul (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (x : (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra G)) :
    Lorentz.iteratedD (complexJetDeriv G) complexJetDeriv_comm s ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℝ] x)
      = (1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℝ] (iteratedJetDeriv G) s x

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.one_tmul_algebraMap
declarations.doc: A real scalar in the complexified jet algebra is the corresponding complex scalar.
declarations.statement:
lemma one_tmul_algebraMap (r : ℝ) :
    (1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℝ] (algebraMap ℝ (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra G) r)
      = algebraMap ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra G)) ((r : ℝ) : ℂ)

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexRepJet_iteratedD_one_tmul_ofA
declarations.doc:
The transformation law of the derivative generators on the complexification, in the
form of `GaugeBoson.TransformsAsGaugeField`.
declarations.statement:
lemma complexRepJet_iteratedD_one_tmul_ofA (U : G.gaugeJetGroup)
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) :
    complexRepJet G U (Lorentz.iteratedD (complexJetDeriv G) complexJetDeriv_comm s
        ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℝ] (ofA G) μ φ))
      = (s.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
          Lorentz.iteratedD (complexJetDeriv G) complexJetDeriv_comm p.2
            ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℝ] (ofA G) μ (G.adjointDualCoeff U⁻¹ p.1 φ))).sum
        + algebraMap ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra G))
            (((φ (G.evalLie (G.iteratedDerivJ s
              (-G.maurerCartan U⁻¹ μ))) : ℝ)) : ℂ)

modules.title: The gauge-field symbols of the jet algebra and their laws
modules.doc:
The derivative symbols `∂_s A_μ^φ` of the complexified gauge-boson jet algebra, with their
Lorentz and gauge laws.

## i. Overview

The derivative symbols `∂_s A_μ^φ` of the complexified gauge-boson jet algebra are packaged as
a family over the derivative multiset, the spacetime index and the dual of the gauge
algebra, `LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.gaugeField`. They satisfy two transformation laws. In the
Lorentz law the symbol carries one covector index and each derivative slot transforms as a
covector. In the gauge law a jet acts by the Leibniz convolution of its adjoint Taylor
coefficients plus the Maurer–Cartan shift.

An algebra map `f` out of the complexified jet algebra carries the symbols into any complex
algebra `B`, as `mapGaugeField f`. When `f` intertwines the gauge and Lorentz actions, the
carried symbols satisfy the same two laws, `GaugeBoson.TransformsAsGaugeField` and
`GaugeBoson.LorentzTransformsAsGaugeField`, and they commute with each other whatever `B` is
(`commute_mapGaugeField`). This is how the gauge fields of the local field algebra of a field
datum, and of any realization of it, inherit their laws, and with them every consequence
proved in the directory `PhyslibAlpha/ClassicalFieldTheory/GaugeTheory/GaugeBoson/AdjointFamily`.
The identity of the jet algebra is the case `transformsAsGaugeField_gaugeField`.

## ii. Key results

- `LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.gaugeField` : the gauge-field symbols of the jet algebra.
- `LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repLorentz_gaugeField` : the Lorentz law.
- `LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repJet_gaugeField` : the gauge law.
- `LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.mapGaugeField` : the symbols carried into another algebra.
- `LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.transformsAsGaugeField_mapGaugeField`,
  `LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.lorentzTransformsAsGaugeField_mapGaugeField` : the two laws along an
  equivariant algebra map.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The gauge-field symbols and their laws
- B. The gauge-field symbols along an algebra map

## iv. References

* None.

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.gaugeField
declarations.doc:
The gauge-field derivative symbols of the complexified gauge-boson jet algebra, as a
family over the derivative multiset, the spacetime index and the dual of the gauge
algebra, the form consumed by the abstract covariance machinery.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def gaugeField (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra →ₗ[ℝ] ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra G)

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.gaugeField_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma gaugeField_apply (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) :
    (gaugeField G) s μ φ = Lorentz.iteratedD (complexJetDeriv G) complexJetDeriv_comm s
      ((1 : ℂ) ⊗ₜ[ℝ] (ofA G) μ φ)

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repLorentz_gaugeField
declarations.doc:
The Lorentz law of the jet algebra. The symbol `∂_s A_μ^φ` carries one covector index,
and each derivative slot transforms as a covector, by `IsLorentzDeriv`.
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentz_gaugeField (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) :
    (complexRepLorentzGroup G) Λ (gaugeField G (List.ofFn l) μ φ) =
      ∑ (p : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)),
        (∏ (i : Fin n), (((SL2C.toLorentzGroup Λ).1 (p i) (l i) : ℝ) : ℂ)) •
      ∑ a, (((Lorentz.SL2C.toLorentzGroup Λ).1 a μ : ℝ) : ℂ) •
        gaugeField G (List.ofFn p) a φ

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.repJet_gaugeField
declarations.doc:
The gauge law of the jet algebra. A jet `U` acts on `∂_s A_μ^φ` by the Leibniz
convolution of the dual adjoint Taylor coefficients of `U⁻¹` against lower symbols, plus
the base-point value of the `s`-th derivative of the Maurer–Cartan form of `U⁻¹`.
declarations.statement:
lemma repJet_gaugeField (U : G.gaugeJetGroup) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) :
    complexRepJet G U (gaugeField G s μ φ) =
      (s.antidiagonal.map fun p => gaugeField G p.2 μ (G.adjointDualCoeff U⁻¹ p.1 φ)).sum
      + algebraMap ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra G)
          (φ (G.evalLie (G.iteratedDerivJ s
            (-G.maurerCartan U⁻¹ μ))))

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.transformsAsGaugeField_gaugeField
declarations.doc: The symbols of the jet algebra transform as a gauge field.
declarations.statement:
lemma transformsAsGaugeField_gaugeField :
    GaugeBoson.TransformsAsGaugeField G (complexRepJet G) (gaugeField G)

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.mapGaugeField
declarations.doc:
The gauge-field symbols `∂_s A_μ^φ` carried into a complex algebra `B` by an algebra map
out of the complexified gauge-boson jet algebra.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def mapGaugeField (f : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra G →ₐ[ℂ] B)
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra →ₗ[ℝ] B

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.mapGaugeField_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma mapGaugeField_apply (f : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra G →ₐ[ℂ] B)
    (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) :
    mapGaugeField f s μ φ = f (gaugeField G s μ φ)

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.commute_mapGaugeField
declarations.doc:
The carried gauge-field symbols commute with each other, being images of a commutative
algebra.
declarations.statement:
lemma commute_mapGaugeField (f : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra G →ₐ[ℂ] B)
    (p q : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ ψ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) :
    Commute (mapGaugeField f p μ φ) (mapGaugeField f q ν ψ)

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.transformsAsGaugeField_mapGaugeField
declarations.doc:
The gauge law along an algebra map intertwining the gauge actions. A jet `U` acts on the
carried symbol `∂_s A_μ^φ` by the Leibniz convolution of the dual adjoint Taylor coefficients
of `U⁻¹` against lower symbols, plus the base-point value of the `s`-th derivative of the
Maurer–Cartan form of `U⁻¹`.
declarations.statement:
lemma transformsAsGaugeField_mapGaugeField (f : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra G →ₐ[ℂ] B)
    (hf : ∀ (U : G.gaugeJetGroup) (x : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra G),
      f (complexRepJet G U x) = repGauge U (f x)) :
    GaugeBoson.TransformsAsGaugeField G repGauge (mapGaugeField f)

declarations.name: LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.lorentzTransformsAsGaugeField_mapGaugeField
declarations.doc:
The Lorentz law along an algebra map intertwining the Lorentz actions. The carried symbol
carries one covector index, and each derivative slot transforms as a covector.
declarations.statement:
lemma lorentzTransformsAsGaugeField_mapGaugeField (f : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra G →ₐ[ℂ] B)
    (hf : ∀ (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (x : ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra G),
      f (complexRepLorentzGroup G Λ x) = repLorentz Λ (f x)) :
    GaugeBoson.LorentzTransformsAsGaugeField repLorentz (mapGaugeField f)

modules.title: The formal total derivative on the gauge-boson jet algebra
modules.doc:
The total spacetime derivative `∂_ν` as a derivation of the gauge-boson jet algebra.

## i. Overview

The formal total spacetime derivative extends from the component functions of the gauge
bosons to their whole jet algebra as a derivation. It is
`SymmetricAlgebra.derivationOfLinear` applied to the shift `∂_s A_μ^φ ↦ ∂_{s + {ν}} A_μ^φ`
on the field-derivative space, which is right multiplication by the derivative symbol `∂_ν`
on the `SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℝ` factor.

The four directional derivatives commute and iterate along a multiset of directions. The
jet algebra is generated by the gauge fields and their iterated derivatives, and the
derivative extends to the complexification `ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra` by base change, where
the ambient Lagrangian theory uses it.

## ii. Key results

- `GaugeBoson.FieldDerivSpace.jetDeriv` : the derivative shift on the component space.
- `LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.jetDeriv` : the formal total derivative, a derivation.
- `LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.iteratedJetDeriv` : the iterated derivative along a multiset.
- `LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.iteratedJetDeriv_ofA` : `∂_s A_μ^φ` as a generator.
- `LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.adjoin_iteratedJetDeriv_eq_top` : the algebra is generated by the
  gauge fields and their derivatives.
- `LocalGaugeFieldAlgebra.complexJetDeriv` : the derivative on the complexification.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The derivative on the field-derivative space
- B. The total derivative on the jet algebra
- C. The iterated total derivative
- D. Generation by the gauge fields and their derivatives
- E. The derivative on the complexification

## iv. References

* None.
