lemma jetDeriv_X_smul (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (z : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V) :
    jetDeriv μ ((X ν : SpaceTimeAlgebra) • z) =
      (if μ = ν then z else 0) + (X ν : SpaceTimeAlgebra) • jetDeriv μ z

declarations.name: jetDerivValue_euler
declarations.doc:
The Euler operator `E = ∑_ρ x_ρ ∂_ρ` multiplies the base-point derivative along `s` by the
order `|s|` of `s`.
declarations.statement:
lemma jetDerivValue_euler (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (z : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V) :
    jetDerivValue s (∑ ρ, (X ρ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) • jetDeriv ρ z) =
      (s.card : ℂ) • jetDerivValue s z

declarations.name: jetDeriv_sum_X_smul
declarations.doc: The derivative of a radial combination, `∂_μ (∑_ν x_ν F_ν) = F_μ + ∑_ν x_ν ∂_μ F_ν`.
declarations.statement:
lemma jetDeriv_sum_X_smul (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (F : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3 → SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V) :
    jetDeriv μ (∑ ν, (X ν : SpaceTimeAlgebra) • F ν) =
      F μ + ∑ ν, (X ν : SpaceTimeAlgebra) • jetDeriv μ (F ν)

declarations.name: jetDeriv_euler
declarations.doc:
The derivative `∂_μ` and the Euler operator commute up to `∂_μ` itself,
`∂_μ (E z) = E (∂_μ z) + ∂_μ z`.
declarations.statement:
lemma jetDeriv_euler (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (z : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V) :
    jetDeriv μ (∑ ρ, (X ρ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) • jetDeriv ρ z) =
      ∑ ρ, (X ρ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) • jetDeriv ρ (jetDeriv μ z) + jetDeriv μ z

declarations.name: jetDeriv_mul
declarations.doc: The formal derivatives are derivations of the algebra of `A`-valued jets.
declarations.statement:
lemma jetDeriv_mul (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x y : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] A) :
    jetDeriv μ (x * y) = jetDeriv μ x * y + x * jetDeriv μ y

declarations.name: jetEval_mul
declarations.doc: Evaluation at the base point is multiplicative on `A`-valued jets.
declarations.statement: lemma jetEval_mul (x y : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] A) : jetEval (x * y) = jetEval x * jetEval y

declarations.name: jetEval_one
declarations.statement: lemma jetEval_one : jetEval (1 : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] A) = 1

declarations.name: jetDerivValue_mul
declarations.doc:
The Leibniz rule for the base-point derivatives of a product of `A`-valued jets. The
derivative along `s` of `x y` is the sum over the splittings `s = t₁ + t₂` of the products of
the derivatives along `t₁` and `t₂`.
declarations.statement:
lemma jetDerivValue_mul (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (x y : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] A) :
    jetDerivValue s (x * y) =
      (s.antidiagonal.map fun p => jetDerivValue p.1 x * jetDerivValue p.2 y).sum

declarations.name: jetDerivValue_commutator
declarations.doc:
The Leibniz rule for the base-point derivatives of a commutator of `A`-valued jets, which
are sums of commutators of base-point derivatives.
declarations.statement:
lemma jetDerivValue_commutator (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (x y : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] A) :
    jetDerivValue s (x * y - y * x) = (s.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
      jetDerivValue p.1 x * jetDerivValue p.2 y -
        jetDerivValue p.2 y * jetDerivValue p.1 x).sum

declarations.name: jetDerivValue_mul_jetOfConstant
declarations.doc: The base-point derivatives of a jet times a constant.
declarations.statement:
lemma jetDerivValue_mul_jetOfConstant (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (x : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] A)
    (a : A) : jetDerivValue s (x * jetOfConstant a) = jetDerivValue s x * a

declarations.name: jetDerivValue_mul_eq_zero
declarations.doc:
The base-point derivative of `R z` along `s` vanishes when `R` vanishes at the base point and
the base-point derivatives of `z` of lower order vanish.
declarations.statement:
lemma jetDerivValue_mul_eq_zero {R z : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] A} (hR : jetEval R = 0)
    {s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)} (hz : ∀ t : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), t.card < s.card →
      jetDerivValue t z = 0) : jetDerivValue s (R * z) = 0

declarations.name: eq_zero_of_euler_eq_mul
declarations.doc:
The vanishing principle for the Euler operator. An `A`-valued jet `z` vanishing at the base
point with `E z = R z`, for `R` vanishing at the base point, is zero.
declarations.statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_euler_eq_mul {R z : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] A} (hR : jetEval R = 0)
    (h0 : jetEval z = 0) (h : ∑ ρ, (X ρ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) • jetDeriv ρ z = R * z) : z = 0

declarations.name: eq_zero_of_euler_add_eq_mul
declarations.doc:
The vanishing principle for the shifted Euler operator. An `A`-valued jet `z` with
`E z + z = R z`, for `R` vanishing at the base point, is zero.
declarations.statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_euler_add_eq_mul {R z : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] A} (hR : jetEval R = 0)
    (h : ∑ ρ, (X ρ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) • jetDeriv ρ z + z = R * z) : z = 0

declarations.name: exists_euler_eq_mul
declarations.doc:
The radial (Euler) transport. For an `A`-valued jet `R` vanishing at the base point, the
radial system `E T = R T` has a solution with `T(0) = 1`. Its base-point derivatives are
fixed order by order, the derivative along `s ≠ 0` being `1/|s|` times the sum over the
splittings `s = t₁ + t₂` of `(∂^{t₁} R)(0) (∂^{t₂} T)(0)`, which involves only lower orders of
`T`.
declarations.statement:
lemma exists_euler_eq_mul (R : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] A) (hR : jetEval R = 0) :
    ∃ T : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] A, jetEval T = 1 ∧
      ∑ ρ, (X ρ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) • jetDeriv ρ T = R * T

declarations.name: euler_mul
declarations.doc: The Euler operator is a derivation of the algebra of `A`-valued jets.
declarations.statement:
lemma euler_mul (x y : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] A) :
    ∑ ρ, (X ρ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) • jetDeriv ρ (x * y) =
      (∑ ρ, (X ρ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) • jetDeriv ρ x) * y +
        x * ∑ ρ, (X ρ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) • jetDeriv ρ y

declarations.name: jetDeriv_mul_sub_mul
declarations.doc:
The derivative of a conjugation defect `a J − J b`, for `J` with `∂_μ J = Ω J` and `a`
with `∂_μ a = a' + [Ω, a]`, is `(a' J − J ∂_μ b) + Ω (a J − J b)`.
declarations.statement:
lemma jetDeriv_mul_sub_mul {a a' b J Ω : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] A} (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (ha : jetDeriv μ a = a' + (Ω * a - a * Ω)) (hJ : jetDeriv μ J = Ω * J) :
    jetDeriv μ (a * J - J * b) = (a' * J - J * jetDeriv μ b) + Ω * (a * J - J * b)

declarations.name: jetDeriv_eq_mul_of_euler
declarations.doc:
The radial transport solves every equation `∂_μ T = Ω_μ T` of a flat family, not only
their radial combination.
declarations.statement:
lemma jetDeriv_eq_mul_of_euler
    (hΩ : ∀ μ ν, jetDeriv μ (Ω ν) - jetDeriv ν (Ω μ) = Ω μ * Ω ν - Ω ν * Ω μ)
    {T : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] A}
    (hT : ∑ ρ, (X ρ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) • jetDeriv ρ T =
      (∑ ν, (X ν : SpaceTimeAlgebra) • Ω ν) * T) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    jetDeriv μ T = Ω μ * T

declarations.name: exists_jetDeriv_eq_mul
declarations.doc:
A flat family `Ω_μ` of `A`-valued jets has, for every `a`, a solution of
`∂_μ T = Ω_μ T` with value `a`, the radial transport of `∑_μ x_μ Ω_μ` times the constant
`a`.
declarations.statement:
lemma exists_jetDeriv_eq_mul
    (hΩ : ∀ μ ν, jetDeriv μ (Ω ν) - jetDeriv ν (Ω μ) = Ω μ * Ω ν - Ω ν * Ω μ) (a : A) :
    ∃ T : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] A, jetEval T = a ∧ ∀ μ, jetDeriv μ T = Ω μ * T

declarations.name: eq_of_jetDeriv_eq_mul
declarations.doc:
A solution of `∂_μ T = Ω_μ T` is determined by its value, since the difference of two solutions
vanishes at the base point and solves the radial system `E D = R D`.

declarations.name: eq_zero_of_jetDeriv_eq_add_mul
declarations.doc:
A family `F i` of `A`-valued jets vanishing at the base point, whose derivatives are
`∂_μ F i = F (d_μ i) + Ω_μ F i`, vanishes, since its base-point derivatives vanish by induction on
their order.
declarations.statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_jetDeriv_eq_add_mul {ι : Type} (F : ι → SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] A)
    (d : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3 → ι → ι) (hF : ∀ μ i, jetDeriv μ (F i) = F (d μ i) + Ω μ * F i)
    (h0 : ∀ i, jetEval (F i) = 0) (i : ι) : F i = 0

modules.title: Fibrewise actions on `V`-valued jets
modules.doc:
Actions on the jets of a field that commute with multiplication by scalar jets, their
coefficients and their conjugates.

## i. Overview

A gauge transformation acts on the jets `SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V` of a `V`-valued field. What
makes that action local is that it is fibrewise. It commutes with multiplication by scalar
jets, so it acts on the values of the field over the identity on spacetime. This file
collects what follows from fibrewise-linearity alone, before any component space is built.

* A fibrewise action is determined by its values on constant jets. For finite-dimensional `V`
  that restriction is a matrix of power series, its coefficient `jetCoeff` in
  `SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗ End V`, which is multiplicative.
* The conjugate action `repConj` on the jets of the conjugate field is again fibrewise.
* Both are natural in the value space. A linear map of value spaces intertwining two
  fibrewise actions intertwines their coefficients, and their conjugate actions.

These are the ingredients from which the action `FieldDerivSpace.repJet` on the
field-derivative space of a matter field is assembled. They live here, upstream of
`MatterField`, because the infinitesimal-action theory of matter fields already needs
`repConj`.

## ii. Key results

- `FieldDerivSpace.coeff_mul_of_smul_comm` : the coefficient of a fibrewise action is
  multiplicative.
- `FieldDerivSpace.repConj` : the conjugate jet action.
- `FieldDerivSpace.repConj_smul_comm` : the conjugate jet action is fibrewise-linear whenever
  the original is.
- `FieldDerivSpace.lTensor_comp_repConj` : the conjugate action is natural in the value space.
- `FieldDerivSpace.jetCoeff` : the coefficient of a fibrewise gauge action.
- `FieldDerivSpace.jetCoeff_naturality` : the coefficient is natural in the value space.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. Fibrewise actions and their coefficients
- B. The conjugate jet action
- C. The coefficient as a matrix of power series
- D. Naturality of the coefficient in the value space

## iv. References

* None.

sections.text: ## A. Fibrewise actions and their coefficients
## B. The conjugate jet action
## C. The coefficient as a matrix of power series

## D. Naturality of the coefficient in the value space

A linear map `f : V →ₗ W` of value spaces intertwining two fibrewise jet actions relates their
coefficients, but not as an equation between elements of two different modules: the comparison takes
place in `SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗ (V →ₗ W)`, into which `SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗ End V` maps by
postcomposition with `f` and `SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗ End W` by precomposition. The two images agree, and
that single identity is what carries the gauge action across a map of value spaces.

declarations.name: FieldDerivSpace.rep_tmul_of_smul_comm
declarations.doc:
A fibrewise action is determined by its values on constant jets. If the gauge
action commutes with multiplication by scalar jets — the statement that it acts on the
values of the field, over the identity on spacetime — then its value on a general jet
`f ⊗ₜ v` is the constant-jet value `rep U (1 ⊗ₜ v)` scaled by `f`.
declarations.statement:
lemma rep_tmul_of_smul_comm
    {rep : Representation ℂ G (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V)}
    (hlin : ∀ (U : G) (χ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (z : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V),
      rep U (χ • z) = χ • rep U z)
    (U : G) (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (v : V) :
    rep U (f ⊗ₜ[ℂ] v) = f • rep U (jetOfConstant v)

declarations.name: FieldDerivSpace.lift_mul_tmul
declarations.doc:
The canonical evaluation is a right module map. Writing `ev` for the canonical
`SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗ End V → (V →ₗ SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗ V)`, `g ⊗ T ↦ (v ↦ g ⊗ₜ T v)`, multiplying on
the right by `b ⊗ T` applies `T` to the argument and scales the value by `b`.
declarations.statement:
lemma lift_mul_tmul (x : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V)
    (b : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (T : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) :
    TensorProduct.lift ((LinearMap.llcomp ℂ V V (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V)).comp
        (TensorProduct.mk ℂ SpaceTimeAlgebra V)) (x * (b ⊗ₜ[ℂ] T)) v
      = b • TensorProduct.lift ((LinearMap.llcomp ℂ V V (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V)).comp
        (TensorProduct.mk ℂ SpaceTimeAlgebra V)) x (T v)

declarations.name: FieldDerivSpace.rep_lift_of_smul_comm
declarations.doc:
A fibrewise action is the `SpaceTimeAlgebra`-linear extension of its coefficient. If the
element `x` of `SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗ End V` records `rep U` on constant jets, then `rep U` agrees
with left multiplication by `x` on every coefficient `y`.
declarations.statement:
lemma rep_lift_of_smul_comm
    {rep : Representation ℂ G (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V)}
    (hlin : ∀ (U : G) (χ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (z : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V),
      rep U (χ • z) = χ • rep U z)
    (U : G) (x : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V)
    (hx : ∀ v : V, TensorProduct.lift ((LinearMap.llcomp ℂ V V (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V)).comp
      (TensorProduct.mk ℂ SpaceTimeAlgebra V)) x v = rep U (jetOfConstant v))
    (y : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) :
    rep U (TensorProduct.lift ((LinearMap.llcomp ℂ V V (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V)).comp
        (TensorProduct.mk ℂ SpaceTimeAlgebra V)) y v)
      = TensorProduct.lift ((LinearMap.llcomp ℂ V V (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V)).comp
        (TensorProduct.mk ℂ SpaceTimeAlgebra V)) (x * y) v

declarations.name: FieldDerivSpace.coeff_mul_of_smul_comm
declarations.doc:
The coefficient of a fibrewise action is multiplicative. Recording `rep` on
constant jets as a family `c` in `SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗ End V`, group multiplication becomes
multiplication in that algebra. This is the identity that makes the induced action on
the symbols a representation, and it needs no basis.
declarations.statement:
lemma coeff_mul_of_smul_comm
    {rep : Representation ℂ G (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V)}
    (hlin : ∀ (U : G) (χ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (z : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V),
      rep U (χ • z) = χ • rep U z)
    (c : G → SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V)
    (hc : ∀ (U : G) (v : V),
      TensorProduct.lift ((LinearMap.llcomp ℂ V V (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V)).comp
        (TensorProduct.mk ℂ SpaceTimeAlgebra V)) (c U) v = rep U (jetOfConstant v))
    (U W : G) (v : V) :
    TensorProduct.lift ((LinearMap.llcomp ℂ V V (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V)).comp
        (TensorProduct.mk ℂ SpaceTimeAlgebra V)) (c U * c W) v
      = rep (U * W) (jetOfConstant v)

declarations.name: FieldDerivSpace.symbolAction_mul
declarations.doc:
The symbol action of a coefficient is an anti-homomorphism. Let `Θ` send a
coefficient `g ⊗ T` in `SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗ End V` to the endomorphism `jetRingAction g ⊗ Tᵀ` of
the symbol space `SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ ⊗ Dual V`. Then `Θ` reverses products. The jet-ring
factor is multiplicative (`jetRingAction_mul`, and `SpaceTimeAlgebra` is commutative) while the
target factor is contravariant (`Module.Dual.transpose_comp`). Composed with `U ↦ U⁻¹`
this is exactly what makes the induced action a representation, with no induction over
the antidiagonal.
declarations.statement:
lemma symbolAction_mul
    (Θ : (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V) →ₗ[ℂ]
      Module.End ℂ (SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ ⊗[ℂ] Module.Dual ℂ V))
    (hΘ : ∀ (g : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (T : Module.End ℂ V),
      Θ (g ⊗ₜ[ℂ] T) = TensorProduct.map (SpaceTimeDerivAlgebraℂ.jetRingAction g)
        (Module.Dual.transpose T))
    (x y : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V) :
    Θ (x * y) = Θ y ∘ₗ Θ x

declarations.name: FieldDerivSpace.lift_congr_leftComm
declarations.doc:
The coefficient of a linear map, canonically. For finite-dimensional `V` the canonical
`SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗ (V →ₗ W) → (V →ₗ SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗ W)` is inverted by reassociating the
contraction `Dual V ⊗ (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗ W) ≃ SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗ (Dual V ⊗ W) ≃ SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗
(V →ₗ W)`. This is the finite-rank input, obtained from `dualTensorHomEquiv` rather than from a
basis. Only the source `V` has to be finite-dimensional; the target is arbitrary, which is what lets
the naturality statements below compare two different value spaces.
declarations.statement:
lemma lift_congr_leftComm [Module.Free ℂ V] [Module.Finite ℂ V]
    (G : Module.Dual ℂ V ⊗[ℂ] (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] W)) (v : V) :
    TensorProduct.lift ((LinearMap.llcomp ℂ V W (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] W)).comp
        (TensorProduct.mk ℂ SpaceTimeAlgebra W))
        ((TensorProduct.congr (LinearEquiv.refl ℂ SpaceTimeAlgebra) (dualTensorHomEquiv ℂ V W))
          (TensorProduct.leftComm ℂ (Module.Dual ℂ V) SpaceTimeAlgebra W G)) v
      = dualTensorHom ℂ V (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] W) G v

declarations.name: FieldDerivSpace.repConj
declarations.doc:
The conjugate jet action. Given a gauge action on the jets of a `V`-valued field,
this is the induced action on the jets of the conjugate field.

It is `Representation.conj rep` — the same underlying maps, read on `ConjModule` — carried
across the identification

  `ConjModule (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V) ≃ₗ[ℂ] SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] ConjModule V`

which is `ConjModule.tensorEquiv` (conjugation is monoidal) followed by
`SpaceTimeAlgebra.starConjEquiv` on the jet-ring factor (the real structure of the jet ring). On
pure tensors the composite is `f ⊗ₜ v ↦ star f ⊗ₜ v`, so `repConj` carries the conjugate
gauge matrix — the physicists' `ψ̄ ↦ ψ̄ U†`.

Being a representation is free, since `LinearEquiv.conjRingEquiv` is a ring equivalence of
endomorphism rings, hence multiplicative.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def repConj (rep : Representation ℂ G (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V)) :
    Representation ℂ G (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] ConjModule V)

declarations.name: FieldDerivSpace.tensorEquiv_congr_conjEquiv_smul
declarations.doc:
The identification conjugates the jet-ring action. Carrying a `V`-valued jet over
to the conjugate side turns multiplication by `star χ` into multiplication by `χ`, and the
`star` on the jet-ring factor is exactly what absorbs the conjugation.
declarations.statement:
lemma tensorEquiv_congr_conjEquiv_smul (χ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (y : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V) :
    ((ConjModule.tensorEquiv (k := ℂ) (M := SpaceTimeAlgebra) (N := V)).symm.trans
        (TensorProduct.congr SpaceTimeAlgebra.starConjEquiv (LinearEquiv.refl ℂ (ConjModule V))))
          (conjEquiv (k := ℂ) (M := SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V) (star χ • y))
      = χ • ((ConjModule.tensorEquiv (k := ℂ) (M := SpaceTimeAlgebra) (N := V)).symm.trans
        (TensorProduct.congr SpaceTimeAlgebra.starConjEquiv (LinearEquiv.refl ℂ (ConjModule V))))
          (conjEquiv (k := ℂ) (M := SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V) y)

declarations.name: FieldDerivSpace.repConj_apply_conjEquiv
declarations.doc:
The conjugate jet action is the original one, read through the identification. On
a jet carried over to the conjugate side, `repConj rep U` is `rep U` applied on the
original side and carried over again. Everything about `repConj` beyond its definition
follows from this.
declarations.statement:
lemma repConj_apply_conjEquiv (rep : Representation ℂ G (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V)) (U : G)
    (y : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V) :
    repConj rep U (((ConjModule.tensorEquiv (k := ℂ) (M := SpaceTimeAlgebra) (N := V)).symm.trans
        (TensorProduct.congr SpaceTimeAlgebra.starConjEquiv (LinearEquiv.refl ℂ (ConjModule V))))
        (conjEquiv (k := ℂ) (M := SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V) y))
      = ((ConjModule.tensorEquiv (k := ℂ) (M := SpaceTimeAlgebra) (N := V)).symm.trans
          (TensorProduct.congr SpaceTimeAlgebra.starConjEquiv (LinearEquiv.refl ℂ (ConjModule V))))
        (conjEquiv (k := ℂ) (M := SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V) (rep U y))

declarations.name: FieldDerivSpace.repConj_smul_comm
declarations.doc:
The conjugate jet action is fibrewise-linear whenever the original is. This is
what lets the coefficient machinery of `coeff_mul_of_smul_comm` be instantiated at
`ConjModule V`, giving the conjugate half of the symbol action.
declarations.statement:
lemma repConj_smul_comm
    {rep : Representation ℂ G (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V)}
    (hlin : ∀ (U : G) (χ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (z : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V),
      rep U (χ • z) = χ • rep U z)
    (U : G) (χ : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (z : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] ConjModule V) :
    repConj rep U (χ • z) = χ • repConj rep U z

declarations.name: FieldDerivSpace.lTensor_conjEquiv_naturality
declarations.doc:
The identification of the conjugate of the jets with the jets of the conjugate is
natural in the value space. A linear map of value spaces acts on either side by the same
underlying map, so carrying a jet over to the conjugate side commutes with it.
declarations.statement:
lemma lTensor_conjEquiv_naturality (f : V →ₗ[ℂ] W) (y : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V) :
    (LinearMap.lTensor SpaceTimeAlgebra (ConjModule.map (k := ℂ) f))
        (((ConjModule.tensorEquiv (k := ℂ) (M := SpaceTimeAlgebra) (N := V)).symm.trans
          (TensorProduct.congr SpaceTimeAlgebra.starConjEquiv (LinearEquiv.refl ℂ (ConjModule V))))
          (conjEquiv (k := ℂ) (M := SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V) y))
      = ((ConjModule.tensorEquiv (k := ℂ) (M := SpaceTimeAlgebra) (N := W)).symm.trans
          (TensorProduct.congr SpaceTimeAlgebra.starConjEquiv (LinearEquiv.refl ℂ (ConjModule W))))
        (conjEquiv (k := ℂ) (M := SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] W)
            ((LinearMap.lTensor SpaceTimeAlgebra f) y))

declarations.name: FieldDerivSpace.lTensor_comp_repConj
declarations.doc:
The conjugate jet action is natural in the value space. A linear map of value
spaces intertwining two fibrewise jet actions intertwines the actions on the jets of the
conjugate fields, through the induced map of conjugate modules. This is what supplies the
conjugate half of the naturality of the gauge action on the field-derivative space, which
does not follow from the unconjugated half.
declarations.statement:
lemma lTensor_comp_repConj (repV : Representation ℂ G (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V))
    (repW : Representation ℂ G (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] W)) (f : V →ₗ[ℂ] W)
    (hf : ∀ U : G, (LinearMap.lTensor SpaceTimeAlgebra f).comp (repV U)
      = (repW U).comp (LinearMap.lTensor SpaceTimeAlgebra f)) (U : G) :
    (LinearMap.lTensor SpaceTimeAlgebra (ConjModule.map (k := ℂ) f)).comp (repConj repV U)
      = (repConj repW U).comp (LinearMap.lTensor SpaceTimeAlgebra (ConjModule.map (k := ℂ) f))

declarations.name: FieldDerivSpace.lift_injective
declarations.doc:
The coefficient is determined by its action on constants. For finite-dimensional `V` the
canonical evaluation `SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗ (V →ₗ W) → (V →ₗ SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗ W)` is injective.
declarations.statement:
lemma lift_injective [Module.Free ℂ V] [Module.Finite ℂ V]
    {x y : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] (V →ₗ[ℂ] W)}
    (h : ∀ v : V, TensorProduct.lift ((LinearMap.llcomp ℂ V W (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] W)).comp
      (TensorProduct.mk ℂ SpaceTimeAlgebra W)) x v = TensorProduct.lift ((LinearMap.llcomp ℂ V W
        (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] W)).comp
      (TensorProduct.mk ℂ SpaceTimeAlgebra W)) y v) : x = y

declarations.name: FieldDerivSpace.jetCoeff
declarations.doc:
The coefficient of a fibrewise gauge action. For finite-dimensional `V`, the
restriction of `rep U` to constant jets is an element of `SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗ End V` — a matrix of
power series, obtained canonically from `dualTensorHomEquiv` rather than from a basis.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def jetCoeff [Module.Free ℂ V] [Module.Finite ℂ V]
    (rep : Representation ℂ G (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V)) (U : G) :
    SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V

declarations.name: FieldDerivSpace.jetCoeff_spec
declarations.doc: The coefficient reproduces `rep U` on constant jets.
declarations.statement:
lemma jetCoeff_spec [Module.Free ℂ V] [Module.Finite ℂ V]
    (rep : Representation ℂ G (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V)) (U : G) (v : V) :
    TensorProduct.lift ((LinearMap.llcomp ℂ V V (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V)).comp
      (TensorProduct.mk ℂ SpaceTimeAlgebra V)) (jetCoeff rep U) v = rep U (jetOfConstant v)

declarations.name: FieldDerivSpace.lift_lTensor_llcomp
declarations.doc: Postcomposing a coefficient with `f` evaluates as applying `f` to the value.
declarations.statement:
lemma lift_lTensor_llcomp (f : V →ₗ[ℂ] W) (x : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) :
    TensorProduct.lift ((LinearMap.llcomp ℂ V W (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] W)).comp
        (TensorProduct.mk ℂ SpaceTimeAlgebra W))
        (LinearMap.lTensor SpaceTimeAlgebra (LinearMap.llcomp ℂ V V W f) x) v
      = LinearMap.lTensor SpaceTimeAlgebra f
        (TensorProduct.lift ((LinearMap.llcomp ℂ V V (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V)).comp
          (TensorProduct.mk ℂ SpaceTimeAlgebra V)) x v)

declarations.name: FieldDerivSpace.lift_lTensor_lcomp
declarations.doc:
Precomposing a coefficient with `f` evaluates as evaluating at the image of the
argument.
declarations.statement:
lemma lift_lTensor_lcomp (f : V →ₗ[ℂ] W) (y : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] Module.End ℂ W) (v : V) :
    TensorProduct.lift ((LinearMap.llcomp ℂ V W (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] W)).comp
        (TensorProduct.mk ℂ SpaceTimeAlgebra W))
        (LinearMap.lTensor SpaceTimeAlgebra (LinearMap.lcomp ℂ W f) y) v
      = TensorProduct.lift ((LinearMap.llcomp ℂ W W (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] W)).comp
        (TensorProduct.mk ℂ SpaceTimeAlgebra W)) y (f v)

declarations.name: FieldDerivSpace.jetCoeff_naturality
declarations.doc:
The coefficient of a fibrewise action is natural in the value space. If `f` maps
the values of one field to the values of another and intertwines their jet actions, then
the coefficient of the first followed by `f` is `f` followed by the coefficient of the
second, as elements of `SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗ (V →ₗ W)`. Both value spaces have to be
finite-dimensional, since both coefficients have to exist; no fibrewise-linearity is used
here, the coefficient being defined for any action.
declarations.statement:
lemma jetCoeff_naturality [Module.Free ℂ V] [Module.Finite ℂ V]
    [Module.Free ℂ W] [Module.Finite ℂ W]
    (repV : Representation ℂ G (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] V))
    (repW : Representation ℂ G (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] W)) (f : V →ₗ[ℂ] W)
    (hf : ∀ U : G, (LinearMap.lTensor SpaceTimeAlgebra f).comp (repV U)
      = (repW U).comp (LinearMap.lTensor SpaceTimeAlgebra f)) (U : G) :
    LinearMap.lTensor SpaceTimeAlgebra (LinearMap.llcomp ℂ V V W f) (jetCoeff repV U)
      = LinearMap.lTensor SpaceTimeAlgebra (LinearMap.lcomp ℂ W f) (jetCoeff repW U)

modules.title: The covariant field algebra of a gauge theory
modules.doc:
The subalgebra of the local field algebra generated by the covariant derivatives of the fields
and of the field strength.

## i. Overview

`T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra` is the complex unital subalgebra of the local field algebra `J(T)`
of a field datum generated by the covariant expressions of the theory. These are the covariant
towers `∇_{l 0} ⋯ ∇_{l (n-1)} ψ` of every matter species and of their conjugate components,
along all ordered tuples of directions, with the undifferentiated fields as the case
`n = 0`, and the field strength with its ordered covariant derivatives `∇_l F_μν` included
from the gauge-only algebra. Being a subalgebra of `J(T)` it inherits the relations of
`J(T)`. No second free algebra is built, and `algHom_ext` gives uniqueness of maps out of
it but not their existence.

Its elements are gauge covariant, not gauge invariant. The jet gauge group preserves it
unconditionally, and its action factors through evaluation to the ordinary gauge group. The Lorentz
group preserves it under `GaugeFieldData.GaugeLorentzCompatible`. The restricted actions are built
with `Representation.restrictSubalgebra`, so they agree with the ambient actions under the inclusion
`Subalgebra.val` by construction.

## ii. Key results

- `GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra` : the covariant field algebra, with
  `LocalCovFieldAlgebra.induction` and `LocalCovFieldAlgebra.algHom_ext`.
- `LocalCovFieldAlgebra.covFermion`, `LocalCovFieldAlgebra.covFieldStrength` and
  companions : the generators as elements of the covariant field algebra.
- `LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repJet`, `LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repValue`,
  `LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repLorentzGroup` : the restricted actions.
- `LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repJet_eq_ofConstant_eval_of_mem`,
  `LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repJet_eq_repValue_eval` : the factorization through evaluation.
- `LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repValue_covFermion_eq_dual` and companions : the ordinary gauge
  group acts on a matter tower through the contragredient of any representation that the
  species representation factors through.
- `LocalCovFieldAlgebra.isLorentzCovDerivTransforms_covFermion` and companions : the Lorentz
  laws of the matter towers in the form `IsLorentzCovDerivTransforms`.
- `LocalCovFieldAlgebra.covFermion_anticomm_covFermion` and companions : the statistics of
  the towers.
- `LocalCovFieldAlgebra.map_mem_polyRange` : a mass-weight algebra map with the covariant
  generators as eigenvectors restricts to the covariant field algebra.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The covariant field algebra
  - A.1. Generation
  - A.2. The generators as elements of the covariant field algebra
- B. Stability under the actions
- C. The restricted actions
  - C.1. The action of the ordinary gauge group
  - C.2. The actions on the generators
- D. The gauge laws through a representation of the value group
- E. The Lorentz laws as covariant derivative transformations
- F. The statistics of the towers
- G. Mass-weight algebra maps

## iv. References

* None.

sections.text: ## A. The covariant field algebra
### A.1. Generation
### A.2. The generators as elements of the covariant field algebra
## B. Stability under the actions
## C. The restricted actions
### C.1. The action of the ordinary gauge group
### C.2. The actions on the generators

## D. The gauge laws through a representation of the value group

A constant jet acts on a matter tower through the zeroth Taylor coefficient of its inverse,
which is the species representation of the inverse value. When that representation factors
through a representation `ρ` of a group `H` along `e : H →* G.group`, the ordinary gauge
group acts on the tower through the contragredient `ρ.dual`.
## E. The Lorentz laws as covariant derivative transformations

## F. The statistics of the towers

The laws of section E of
`PhyslibAlpha.ClassicalFieldTheory.GaugeTheory.LocalFieldAlgebra.CovariantDeriv` read in the
covariant field algebra.

## G. Mass-weight algebra maps

A mass-weight algebra map `P : J(T) →ₐ[ℂ] Polynomial J(T)` for which every covariant generator
is an eigenvector carries the covariant field algebra into the polynomials over it, and so
restricts to a mass-weight algebra map of the covariant field algebra through
`Subalgebra.polyRestrict`.

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.ringLocalFieldAlgebra
declarations.doc:
The ring structure of the local field algebra, as found by instance search, recorded as a
single constant. The covariant field algebra is a subalgebra for this structure, so that its
type, and every type built on it, stays small; the instance term found by search runs through
the whole tensor-product structure and makes rewriting and type checking slow.
declarations.statement: noncomputable abbrev ringLocalFieldAlgebra : Ring T.LocalFieldAlgebra

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.algebraLocalFieldAlgebra
declarations.doc:
The complex algebra structure of the local field algebra, as found by instance search,
recorded as a single constant for the same reason as `ringLocalFieldAlgebra`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable abbrev algebraLocalFieldAlgebra :
    @Algebra ℂ T.LocalFieldAlgebra _ T.ringLocalFieldAlgebra.toSemiring

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra
declarations.doc:
The covariant field algebra of a field datum, the complex unital subalgebra of its local
field algebra generated by the included field-strength tower `∇_l F_μν` and the covariant
matter towers `∇_l ψ` of every species, unconjugated and conjugate, along all ordered
tuples of directions.

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.covGenerators
declarations.doc:
The generating set of `LocalCovFieldAlgebra`, the included field-strength tower and the
covariant matter towers of every species, unconjugated and conjugate, along all ordered
tuples of directions.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def covGenerators : Set T.LocalFieldAlgebra

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.instRingLocalCovFieldAlgebra
declarations.doc:
The covariant field algebra is a ring, as a subalgebra of the local field algebra. The
instance is stated explicitly because instance search for `Subalgebra.toRing` times out at
this algebra. Its semiring part is the semiring structure of the subalgebra, which instance
search finds for multiplication and the module structure, so that the two agree without
unfolding.
declarations.statement: noncomputable instance instRingLocalCovFieldAlgebra : Ring T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra

declarations.doc: The covariant field algebra is a complex algebra, at the ring instance just given.
declarations.statement: noncomputable instance : Algebra ℂ T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.instModuleComplexLocalCovFieldAlgebra
declarations.doc:
The covariant field algebra is a complex vector space, by its algebra structure. This is
the structure instance search finds; it is recorded directly, at high priority, because the
search first tries the normed structures and times out looking for a seminorm on the tensor
factors of the local field algebra.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable instance (priority := high) instModuleComplexLocalCovFieldAlgebra :
    Module ℂ T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra

declarations.doc:
The covariant field algebra is a semigroup, by the semiring structure of the subalgebra. The
instance is given directly, at high priority, because instance search otherwise first looks for
a semigroup structure on the local field algebra and times out searching its tensor factors.
declarations.statement: noncomputable instance (priority := high) : Semigroup T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.instModuleRealLocalCovFieldAlgebra
declarations.doc:
The covariant field algebra is a real vector space, by restricting the complex scalars. This
is the structure instance search finds; it is recorded directly, at high priority, because the
search times out in some contexts, in particular for `SMul ℝ`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable instance (priority := high) instModuleRealLocalCovFieldAlgebra :
    Module ℝ T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra

declarations.doc:
The real scalar multiplication on the covariant field algebra, from its real vector space
structure.
declarations.statement: noncomputable instance (priority := high) : SMul ℝ T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.instNonAssocRingLocalCovFieldAlgebra
declarations.doc:
The covariant field algebra is a non-associative ring, by its ring structure. Given
directly, at high priority, because instance search otherwise looks for the structure on the
local field algebra and times out searching its tensor factors.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable instance (priority := high) instNonAssocRingLocalCovFieldAlgebra :
    NonAssocRing T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.instNonUnitalNonAssocSemiringLocalCovFieldAlgebra
declarations.doc:
The covariant field algebra is a non-unital non-associative semiring, by its ring structure.
Given directly, at high priority, for the same reason as
`instNonAssocRingLocalCovFieldAlgebra`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable instance (priority := high) instNonUnitalNonAssocSemiringLocalCovFieldAlgebra :
    NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.instNonUnitalNonAssocRingLocalCovFieldAlgebra
declarations.doc:
The covariant field algebra is a non-unital non-associative ring, by its ring structure.
Given directly, at high priority, for the same reason as
`instNonAssocRingLocalCovFieldAlgebra`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable instance (priority := high) instNonUnitalNonAssocRingLocalCovFieldAlgebra :
    NonUnitalNonAssocRing T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.instInvolutiveNegLocalCovFieldAlgebra
declarations.doc:
Negation on the covariant field algebra is involutive, by its additive group structure.
Given directly, at high priority, for the same reason as
`instNonAssocRingLocalCovFieldAlgebra`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable instance (priority := high) instInvolutiveNegLocalCovFieldAlgebra :
    InvolutiveNeg T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.instZeroHomClassLinearMap
declarations.doc:
Linear endomorphisms of the covariant field algebra send zero to zero. Given directly, at
high priority, since the generic search for `ZeroHomClass` on these maps times out.
declarations.statement:
instance (priority := high) instZeroHomClassLinearMap :
    ZeroHomClass (T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra →ₗ[ℂ] T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra) T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra
      T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.instAddHomClassAlgHomPolynomial
declarations.doc:
Algebra maps from the covariant field algebra to its polynomials, such as a mass-weight
polynomial, are additive. Given directly, at high priority, since the generic search for
`AddHomClass` on these maps tries the semilinear and normed classes first, looking for a
field structure on the local field algebra, and times out.
declarations.statement:
instance (priority := high) instAddHomClassAlgHomPolynomial :
    AddHomClass (T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra →ₐ[ℂ] Polynomial T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra)
      T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra (Polynomial T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.instMulActionHomClassAlgHomPolynomial
declarations.doc:
Algebra maps from the covariant field algebra to its polynomials commute with the complex
scalars. Given directly, at high priority, for the same reason as
`instAddHomClassAlgHomPolynomial`.
declarations.statement:
instance (priority := high) instMulActionHomClassAlgHomPolynomial :
    MulActionHomClass (T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra →ₐ[ℂ] Polynomial T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra) ℂ
      T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra (Polynomial T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.covDerivFieldStrength_mem
declarations.statement:
lemma covDerivFieldStrength_mem (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) :
    T.covDerivFieldStrength l μ ν φ ∈ T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.covDerivFermion_mem
declarations.statement:
lemma covDerivFermion_mem (i : T.FermionSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (T.FermionValue i)) : T.covDerivFermion i l φ ∈ T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.covDerivConjFermion_mem
declarations.statement:
lemma covDerivConjFermion_mem (i : T.FermionSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.FermionValue i))) :
    T.covDerivConjFermion i l φ ∈ T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.covDerivBoson_mem
declarations.statement:
lemma covDerivBoson_mem (j : T.BosonSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (T.BosonValue j)) : T.covDerivBoson j l φ ∈ T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.covDerivConjBoson_mem
declarations.statement:
lemma covDerivConjBoson_mem (j : T.BosonSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.BosonValue j))) :
    T.covDerivConjBoson j l φ ∈ T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.covGenerators_cases
declarations.doc: Case analysis on the covariant generators.
declarations.statement:
lemma covGenerators_cases {P : T.LocalFieldAlgebra → Prop} {b : T.LocalFieldAlgebra}
    (hb : b ∈ T.covGenerators)
    (hF : ∀ (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra),
      P (T.covDerivFieldStrength l μ ν φ))
    (hψ : ∀ (i : T.FermionSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
      (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (T.FermionValue i)), P (T.covDerivFermion i l φ))
    (hψc : ∀ (i : T.FermionSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
      (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.FermionValue i))), P (T.covDerivConjFermion i l φ))
    (hφ : ∀ (j : T.BosonSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
      (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (T.BosonValue j)), P (T.covDerivBoson j l φ))
    (hφc : ∀ (j : T.BosonSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
      (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.BosonValue j))), P (T.covDerivConjBoson j l φ)) :
    P b

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.induction
declarations.doc:
The generation principle. A property holding on the covariant generators and on the
scalars, and closed under sums and products, holds on the whole covariant field
algebra.
declarations.statement:
lemma induction {P : T.LocalFieldAlgebra → Prop} {x : T.LocalFieldAlgebra}
    (hx : x ∈ T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra)
    (hF : ∀ (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra),
      P (T.covDerivFieldStrength l μ ν φ))
    (hψ : ∀ (i : T.FermionSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
      (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (T.FermionValue i)), P (T.covDerivFermion i l φ))
    (hψc : ∀ (i : T.FermionSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
      (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.FermionValue i))), P (T.covDerivConjFermion i l φ))
    (hφ : ∀ (j : T.BosonSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
      (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (T.BosonValue j)), P (T.covDerivBoson j l φ))
    (hφc : ∀ (j : T.BosonSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
      (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.BosonValue j))), P (T.covDerivConjBoson j l φ))
    (halg : ∀ z : ℂ, P (z • (1 : T.LocalFieldAlgebra)))
    (hadd : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y))
    (hmul : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x * y)) : P x

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.mapsTo
declarations.doc:
An algebra endomorphism carrying the covariant generators into the covariant field
algebra carries the whole covariant field algebra into itself.
declarations.statement:
lemma mapsTo (f : T.LocalFieldAlgebra →ₐ[ℂ] T.LocalFieldAlgebra)
    (hgen : ∀ b ∈ T.covGenerators, f b ∈ T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra)
    {x : T.LocalFieldAlgebra} (hx : x ∈ T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra) :
    f x ∈ T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.algHom_ext
declarations.doc:
Two algebra maps out of the covariant field algebra agreeing on the covariant
generators are equal. This is uniqueness only, since the covariant field algebra is not free on
its generators, so an assignment of their images does not by itself define a map.
declarations.statement:
lemma algHom_ext {B : Type} [Semiring B] [Algebra ℂ B]
    {f g : ↥T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra →ₐ[ℂ] B}
    (h : ∀ b (hb : b ∈ T.covGenerators), f ⟨b, Algebra.subset_adjoin hb⟩
      = g ⟨b, Algebra.subset_adjoin hb⟩) : f = g

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.covFieldStrength
declarations.doc:
The included field-strength tower `∇_l F_μν^φ`, as elements of the covariant field
algebra.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def covFieldStrength (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) : T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.covFermion
declarations.doc:
The covariant tower `∇_l ψ^φ` of a fermionic species, as elements of the covariant field
algebra.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def covFermion (i : T.FermionSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    Module.Dual ℂ (T.FermionValue i) →ₗ[ℂ] T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.covConjFermion
declarations.doc:
The conjugate covariant tower of a fermionic species, as elements of the covariant field
algebra.

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.covBoson
declarations.doc: The covariant tower of a bosonic species, as elements of the covariant field algebra.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def covBoson (j : T.BosonSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    Module.Dual ℂ (T.BosonValue j) →ₗ[ℂ] T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.covConjBoson
declarations.doc:
The conjugate covariant tower of a bosonic species, as elements of the covariant field
algebra.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def covConjBoson (j : T.BosonSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.BosonValue j)) →ₗ[ℂ] T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.coe_covFieldStrength
declarations.statement:
lemma coe_covFieldStrength (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) :
    (covFieldStrength T l μ ν φ : T.LocalFieldAlgebra) = T.covDerivFieldStrength l μ ν φ

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.coe_covFermion
declarations.statement:
lemma coe_covFermion (i : T.FermionSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (T.FermionValue i)) :
    (covFermion T i l φ : T.LocalFieldAlgebra) = T.covDerivFermion i l φ

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.coe_covConjFermion
declarations.statement:
lemma coe_covConjFermion (i : T.FermionSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.FermionValue i))) :
    (covConjFermion T i l φ : T.LocalFieldAlgebra) = T.covDerivConjFermion i l φ

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.coe_covBoson
declarations.statement:
lemma coe_covBoson (j : T.BosonSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (T.BosonValue j)) :
    (covBoson T j l φ : T.LocalFieldAlgebra) = T.covDerivBoson j l φ

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.coe_covConjBoson
declarations.statement:
lemma coe_covConjBoson (j : T.BosonSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.BosonValue j))) :
    (covConjBoson T j l φ : T.LocalFieldAlgebra) = T.covDerivConjBoson j l φ

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repJet_mem
declarations.doc:
The jet gauge group preserves the covariant field algebra, since a jet carries each generator
to a generator of the same tower.
declarations.statement:
lemma repJet_mem (U : G.gaugeJetGroup) {x : T.LocalFieldAlgebra} (hx : x ∈ T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra) :
    T.repJet U x ∈ T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_mem
declarations.doc:
The Lorentz group preserves the covariant field algebra under
`GaugeFieldData.GaugeLorentzCompatible`, the generators mixing among themselves.
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_mem (hGL : T.GaugeLorentzCompatible) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    {x : T.LocalFieldAlgebra} (hx : x ∈ T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra) :
    T.repLorentzGroup Λ x ∈ T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repJet
declarations.doc:
The action of the jet gauge group on the covariant field algebra, restricted from the
local field algebra.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def repJet : Representation ℂ G.gaugeJetGroup T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.coe_repJet
declarations.statement:
lemma coe_repJet (U : G.gaugeJetGroup) (x : T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra) :
    (repJet T U x : T.LocalFieldAlgebra) = T.repJet U x

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repJet_apply_mul
declarations.statement:
lemma repJet_apply_mul (U : G.gaugeJetGroup) (x y : T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra) :
    repJet T U (x * y) = repJet T U x * repJet T U y

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repLorentzGroup
declarations.doc:
The action of the Lorentz group on the covariant field algebra, restricted from the
local field algebra under `GaugeFieldData.GaugeLorentzCompatible`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def repLorentzGroup (hGL : T.GaugeLorentzCompatible) :
    Representation ℂ SL(2,ℂ) T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.coe_repLorentzGroup
declarations.statement:
lemma coe_repLorentzGroup (hGL : T.GaugeLorentzCompatible) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (x : T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra) :
    (repLorentzGroup T hGL Λ x : T.LocalFieldAlgebra) = T.repLorentzGroup Λ x

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_apply_mul
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_apply_mul (hGL : T.GaugeLorentzCompatible) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (x y : T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra) :
    repLorentzGroup T hGL Λ (x * y) = repLorentzGroup T hGL Λ x * repLorentzGroup T hGL Λ y

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repValue
declarations.doc:
The action of the ordinary gauge group on the covariant field algebra, the jet action at
the constant jets.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def repValue : Representation ℂ G.group T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.coe_repValue
declarations.statement:
lemma coe_repValue (g : G.group) (x : T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra) :
    (repValue T g x : T.LocalFieldAlgebra) = T.repJet (G.gaugeJetOfConstant g) x

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repValue_apply_mul
declarations.statement:
lemma repValue_apply_mul (g : G.group) (x y : T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra) :
    repValue T g (x * y) = repValue T g x * repValue T g y

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repJet_eq_ofConstant_eval_of_mem
declarations.doc:
A jet acts on every element of the covariant field algebra as the constant jet of its
value, stated in the local field algebra.
declarations.statement:
lemma repJet_eq_ofConstant_eval_of_mem (U : G.gaugeJetGroup)
    {x : T.LocalFieldAlgebra} (hx : x ∈ T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra) :
    T.repJet U x = T.repJet (G.gaugeJetOfConstant (G.evalGaugeJet U)) x

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repJet_eq_repValue_eval
declarations.doc:
The action of the jet gauge group on the covariant field algebra factors through
evaluation. A jet acts as the constant jet of its value, so the derivatives of a gauge
transformation act trivially on covariant expressions.
declarations.statement:
lemma repJet_eq_repValue_eval (U : G.gaugeJetGroup)
    (x : T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra) : repJet T U x = repValue T (G.evalGaugeJet U) x

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repValue_covFieldStrength
declarations.doc:
The ordinary gauge group rotates the adjoint index of the field-strength tower through
the dual adjoint action of the inverse.
declarations.statement:
lemma repValue_covFieldStrength (g : G.group) (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) :
    repValue T g (covFieldStrength T l μ ν φ)
      = covFieldStrength T l μ ν ((G.adjointRep g⁻¹).dualMap φ)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repJet_covFieldStrength
declarations.doc: A jet acts on the field-strength tower through the value of its inverse alone.
declarations.statement:
lemma repJet_covFieldStrength (U : G.gaugeJetGroup) (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) :
    repJet T U (covFieldStrength T l μ ν φ)
      = covFieldStrength T l μ ν
          ((G.adjointRep (G.evalGaugeJet U⁻¹)).dualMap φ)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repJet_covFermion
declarations.doc:
A jet acts on the covariant tower of a fermionic species through the zeroth dual Taylor
coefficient of its inverse on the value index.
declarations.statement:
lemma repJet_covFermion (U : G.gaugeJetGroup) (i : T.FermionSpecies) {n : ℕ}
    (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (T.FermionValue i)) :
    repJet T U (covFermion T i l φ)
      = covFermion T i l (repDualCoeff (T.fermion i).repJet U⁻¹ 0 φ)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repJet_covConjFermion
declarations.statement:
lemma repJet_covConjFermion (U : G.gaugeJetGroup) (i : T.FermionSpecies) {n : ℕ}
    (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.FermionValue i))) :
    repJet T U (covConjFermion T i l φ)
      = covConjFermion T i l
          (repDualCoeff (FieldDerivSpace.repConj (T.fermion i).repJet) U⁻¹ 0 φ)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repJet_covBoson
GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repJet_covConjBoson
declarations.statement:
lemma repJet_covConjBoson (U : G.gaugeJetGroup) (j : T.BosonSpecies) {n : ℕ}
    (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.BosonValue j))) :
    repJet T U (covConjBoson T j l φ)
      = covConjBoson T j l
          (repDualCoeff (FieldDerivSpace.repConj (T.boson j).repJet) U⁻¹ 0 φ)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_covFieldStrength
declarations.doc:
The Lorentz law of the field-strength tower in the covariant field algebra. Every
covariant slot and both covector indices mix by the columns of the Lorentz matrix.
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_covFieldStrength (hGL : T.GaugeLorentzCompatible) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) :
    repLorentzGroup T hGL Λ (covFieldStrength T (List.ofFn l) μ ν φ)
      = ∑ p : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), (∏ k, L[Λ] (p k) (l k)) •
          ∑ a, L[Λ] a μ • ∑ b, L[Λ] b ν • covFieldStrength T (List.ofFn p) a b φ

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_covFermion
declarations.doc:
The Lorentz law of the covariant tower of a fermionic species in the covariant field
algebra. Every covariant slot mixes by the columns of the Lorentz matrix and the value
index transforms contragrediently.
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_covFermion (hGL : T.GaugeLorentzCompatible) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (i : T.FermionSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (T.FermionValue i)) :
    repLorentzGroup T hGL Λ (covFermion T i l φ)
      = ∑ p : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), (∏ k, L[Λ] (p k) (l k)) •
          covFermion T i p ((T.fermion i).repLorentz.dual Λ φ)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_covConjFermion
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_covConjFermion (hGL : T.GaugeLorentzCompatible) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (i : T.FermionSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.FermionValue i))) :
    repLorentzGroup T hGL Λ (covConjFermion T i l φ)
      = ∑ p : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), (∏ k, L[Λ] (p k) (l k)) •
          covConjFermion T i p ((T.fermion i).repLorentz.conj.dual Λ φ)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_covBoson
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_covBoson (hGL : T.GaugeLorentzCompatible) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (j : T.BosonSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (T.BosonValue j)) :
    repLorentzGroup T hGL Λ (covBoson T j l φ)
      = ∑ p : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), (∏ k, L[Λ] (p k) (l k)) •
          covBoson T j p ((T.boson j).repLorentz.dual Λ φ)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repLorentzGroup_covConjBoson
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_covConjBoson (hGL : T.GaugeLorentzCompatible) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (j : T.BosonSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.BosonValue j))) :
    repLorentzGroup T hGL Λ (covConjBoson T j l φ)
      = ∑ p : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3), (∏ k, L[Λ] (p k) (l k)) •
          covConjBoson T j p ((T.boson j).repLorentz.conj.dual Λ φ)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repCoeff_zero_gaugeJetOfConstant
declarations.doc:
The zeroth Taylor coefficient of the jet action of a matter field at the constant jet of
a group element is the action of that element.
declarations.statement:
lemma repCoeff_zero_gaugeJetOfConstant (M : G.MatterField) (g : G.group) :
    GlobalGaugeGroup.repCoeff M.repJet (G.gaugeJetOfConstant g) 0 =
      (((M.rep g : (M.V →L[ℂ] M.V)ˣ) : M.V →L[ℂ] M.V) : M.V →ₗ[ℂ] M.V)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repValue_covFermion_eq_dual
declarations.doc:
The ordinary gauge group acts on the covariant tower of a fermionic species through the
contragredient of a representation `ρ` that the species representation factors through.
declarations.statement:
lemma repValue_covFermion_eq_dual {H : Type} [Group H] (e : H →* G.group)
    (i : T.FermionSpecies) {ρ : Representation ℂ H (T.FermionValue i)}
    (hρ : ∀ h : H, ((((T.fermion i).rep (e h) : ((T.fermion i).V →L[ℂ] (T.fermion i).V)ˣ) :
      (T.fermion i).V →L[ℂ] (T.fermion i).V) : (T.fermion i).V →ₗ[ℂ] (T.fermion i).V) = ρ h)
    (h : H) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (T.FermionValue i)) :
    repValue T (e h) (covFermion T i l φ) = covFermion T i l (ρ.dual h φ)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repValue_covConjFermion_eq_dual
declarations.doc:
The conjugate form of `repValue_covFermion_eq_dual`. The conjugate tower transforms
through the conjugate contragredient `ρ.conj.dual`.
declarations.statement:
lemma repValue_covConjFermion_eq_dual {H : Type} [Group H] (e : H →* G.group)
    (i : T.FermionSpecies) {ρ : Representation ℂ H (T.FermionValue i)}
    (hρ : ∀ h : H, ((((T.fermion i).rep (e h) : ((T.fermion i).V →L[ℂ] (T.fermion i).V)ˣ) :
      (T.fermion i).V →L[ℂ] (T.fermion i).V) : (T.fermion i).V →ₗ[ℂ] (T.fermion i).V) = ρ h)
    (h : H) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.FermionValue i))) :
    repValue T (e h) (covConjFermion T i l φ) = covConjFermion T i l (ρ.conj.dual h φ)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repValue_covBoson_eq_dual
declarations.doc:
The ordinary gauge group acts on the covariant tower of a bosonic species through the
contragredient of a representation `ρ` that the species representation factors through.
declarations.statement:
lemma repValue_covBoson_eq_dual {H : Type} [Group H] (e : H →* G.group)
    (j : T.BosonSpecies) {ρ : Representation ℂ H (T.BosonValue j)}
    (hρ : ∀ h : H, ((((T.boson j).rep (e h) : ((T.boson j).V →L[ℂ] (T.boson j).V)ˣ) :
      (T.boson j).V →L[ℂ] (T.boson j).V) : (T.boson j).V →ₗ[ℂ] (T.boson j).V) = ρ h)
    (h : H) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (T.BosonValue j)) :
    repValue T (e h) (covBoson T j l φ) = covBoson T j l (ρ.dual h φ)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repValue_covConjBoson_eq_dual
declarations.doc: The conjugate form of `repValue_covBoson_eq_dual`.
declarations.statement:
lemma repValue_covConjBoson_eq_dual {H : Type} [Group H] (e : H →* G.group)
    (j : T.BosonSpecies) {ρ : Representation ℂ H (T.BosonValue j)}
    (hρ : ∀ h : H, ((((T.boson j).rep (e h) : ((T.boson j).V →L[ℂ] (T.boson j).V)ˣ) :

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.isLorentzCovDerivTransforms_covFermion
declarations.doc:
The covariant tower of a fermionic species transforms as the covariant derivatives of a
field in any representation equal to the Lorentz representation of the species.
declarations.statement:
lemma isLorentzCovDerivTransforms_covFermion (hGL : T.GaugeLorentzCompatible)
    (i : T.FermionSpecies) {ρ : Representation ℂ SL(2,ℂ) (T.FermionValue i)}
    (hρ : (T.fermion i).repLorentz = ρ) :
    IsLorentzCovDerivTransforms (repLorentzGroup T hGL) ρ (fun {_n} l => covFermion T i l)

declarations.doc:
The conjugate covariant tower of a fermionic species transforms in the conjugate
representation.

The covariant tower of a bosonic species transforms as the covariant derivatives of a

The conjugate covariant tower of a bosonic species transforms in the conjugate

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.commute_covFieldStrength
declarations.doc: The field-strength tower is central in the covariant field algebra.
declarations.statement:
lemma commute_covFieldStrength (l : List (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (φ : Module.Dual ℝ G.lieSubalgebra) (x : T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra) :
    Commute (covFieldStrength T l μ ν φ) x

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.commute_covBoson
declarations.doc: The covariant tower of a bosonic species is central in the covariant field algebra.
declarations.statement:
lemma commute_covBoson (j : T.BosonSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (T.BosonValue j)) (x : T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra) :
    Commute (covBoson T j l φ) x

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.commute_covConjBoson
declarations.doc:
The conjugate covariant tower of a bosonic species is central in the covariant field
algebra.
declarations.statement:
lemma commute_covConjBoson (j : T.BosonSpecies) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3))
    (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.BosonValue j))) (x : T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra) :
    Commute (covConjBoson T j l φ) x

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.covFermion_anticomm_covFermion
declarations.doc: Two fermionic towers anticommute in the covariant field algebra.
declarations.statement:
lemma covFermion_anticomm_covFermion (i j : T.FermionSpecies) {n m : ℕ}
    (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (T.FermionValue i))
    (l' : Fin m → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ' : Module.Dual ℂ (T.FermionValue j)) :
    covFermion T i l φ * covFermion T j l' φ' = -(covFermion T j l' φ' * covFermion T i l φ)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.covFermion_anticomm_covConjFermion
declarations.doc: A fermionic tower anticommutes with a conjugate fermionic tower.
declarations.statement:
lemma covFermion_anticomm_covConjFermion (i j : T.FermionSpecies) {n m : ℕ}
    (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (T.FermionValue i))
    (l' : Fin m → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ' : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.FermionValue j))) :
    covFermion T i l φ * covConjFermion T j l' φ'
      = -(covConjFermion T j l' φ' * covFermion T i l φ)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.covConjFermion_anticomm_covFermion
declarations.doc: A conjugate fermionic tower anticommutes with a fermionic tower.
declarations.statement:
lemma covConjFermion_anticomm_covFermion (i j : T.FermionSpecies) {n m : ℕ}
    (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.FermionValue i)))
    (l' : Fin m → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ' : Module.Dual ℂ (T.FermionValue j)) :
    covConjFermion T i l φ * covFermion T j l' φ'
      = -(covFermion T j l' φ' * covConjFermion T i l φ)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.covConjFermion_anticomm_covConjFermion
declarations.doc: Two conjugate fermionic towers anticommute.
declarations.statement:
lemma covConjFermion_anticomm_covConjFermion (i j : T.FermionSpecies) {n m : ℕ}
    (l : Fin n → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.FermionValue i)))
    (l' : Fin m → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (φ' : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule (T.FermionValue j))) :
    covConjFermion T i l φ * covConjFermion T j l' φ'
      = -(covConjFermion T j l' φ' * covConjFermion T i l φ)

declarations.name: GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.map_mem_polyRange
declarations.doc:
A mass-weight algebra map with the covariant generators as eigenvectors carries the
covariant field algebra into the polynomials with coefficients in it.
declarations.statement:
lemma map_mem_polyRange (P : T.LocalFieldAlgebra →ₐ[ℂ] Polynomial T.LocalFieldAlgebra)
    (hgen : ∀ b ∈ T.covGenerators, ∃ w : ℕ, P b = Polynomial.monomial w b)
    (x : T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra) :
    P (x : T.LocalFieldAlgebra)
      ∈ Subalgebra.polyRange (R := ℂ) (A := T.LocalFieldAlgebra) T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra

modules.title: The covariant generators by kind and mass weight
modules.doc:
The covariant generators of a gauge field theory sorted by kind and mass weight, and the
products of them, which span the covariant field algebra.

## i. Overview

The covariant field algebra `T.LocalCovFieldAlgebra` of a field datum `T` is generated by
three kinds of covariant expressions.

- Gauge. The field strength `F_μν` and its covariant derivatives `∇_l F_μν`.
- Scalar. The bosonic matter fields `φ`, their conjugates `φ†`, and their covariant
  derivatives.
- Fermion. The fermionic matter fields `ψ`, their conjugates `ψ̄`, and their covariant
  derivatives.

Each generator also carries a mass weight, twice its mass dimension. The tower `∇_l F_μν` has
weight `4 + 2 |l|`, and the tower of `n` covariant derivatives of a species of mass weight `c`,
or of its conjugate, has weight `c + 2 n`. The set `T.weightedGenerators k w` collects the
generators of kind `k` and weight `w`.

A product of generators is recorded as a list of generators, each with its kind and weight. The
set `T.weightedMonomials A w` holds the products whose set of kinds is `A` and whose weights add
up to `w`. Every element of the covariant field algebra is a combination of such products. The
algebra is not free on its generators, so this combination is not unique, and every argument
below works with the products as a spanning set only.

The gauge and Lorentz groups carry each generator into the span of the generators of the same
kind and weight, so they preserve the span of the products of any given kinds and weight. When
the mass weights of the fermionic species are odd and those of the bosonic species even, the
mass weight also records the statistics: two products of weights `v` and `w` exchange up to the
sign `(-1) ^ (v * w)`.

## ii. Key results

- `GaugeFieldData.FieldKind` : the three kinds of covariant generators.
- `GaugeFieldData.kindGenerators`, `GaugeFieldData.weightedGenerators` : the generators of a
  given kind, and of a given kind and mass weight.
- `GaugeFieldData.weightedMonomials` : the products of generators of given kinds and weight.
- `GaugeFieldData.mem_span_weightedMonomials` : the products span the covariant field algebra.
- `GaugeFieldData.map_mem_span_weightedMonomials` : a unital multiplicative map preserving the
  kinds and weights of the generators preserves the span of the products of given kinds and
  weight.
- `GaugeFieldData.anticomm_of_mem_span_kindGenerators_fermion` : the fermionic generators
  anticommute on their span.
- `GaugeFieldData.mul_eq_smul_mul_of_mem_span_weightedMonomials` : combinations of products of
  weights `v` and `w` exchange up to the sign `(-1) ^ (v * w)`.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The kinds of covariant generators
- B. The generators of a given kind and mass weight
  - B.1. Case analysis
  - B.2. Bounds on the mass weights
- C. The actions on the generators
- D. Products of generators
  - D.1. The products span the covariant field algebra
  - D.2. Maps preserving the products
- E. The statistics of the generators
  - E.1. Commutation and anticommutation by kind
  - E.2. The sign of an exchange from the mass weights

## iv. References

* None.
